jobDescription:
Technical Program Manager (TPM)

Role Overview
The Technical Program Manager (TPM) drives complex technical programs from planning through execution and delivery.
At redBus, TPMs are expected to be technical leaders, execution drivers, and force multipliers who bring clarity to ambiguity, improve delivery predictability, and use AI and automation to make teams more effective.
Whether you're helping launch new features, scaling core backend APIs, setting up regional compliance, or introducing new AI capabilities, you will be the key collaborative partner who connects the dots, resolves cross-team dependencies, and keeps everyone moving forward smoothly.


Key Responsibilities
Program Delivery
  • Cross-Domain Leadership: Lead complex technical programs, geo-expansions, and cross-functional initiatives across the organization.
  • Goal Translation : Translate business goals into clear plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
  • Proactive Risk Management : Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early and drive mitigation plans to closure.
  • Strategic Partnering : Partner with Product and Engineering on prioritization, capacity alignment, and execution trade-offs.
  • Release Readiness : Drive release readiness and confidence across Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, Product, and Operations.
  • Stakeholder Governance : Communicate program health, risks, decisions, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
Engineering Execution
  • Architectural Review: Participate actively in architecture, API, integration, and solution reviews to identify technical risks and dependencies early.
  • Sprint Readiness (DoR): Drive and enforce a strong Definition of Readiness (DoR) before sprint commitment.
  • Quality & Shift-Left Maturity: Promote Shift-Left practices by aligning Development and QA early, ensuring test case definition before coding begins.
  • Operational Metrics: Track and optimize delivery metrics such as delivery predictability, defect density, build delays, and release quality.
  • Continuous Improvement: Improve planning, execution, governance, and cross-team collaboration through data-driven interventions and post-sprint RCAs.
AI Program Leadership
  • AI Feature Delivery: Drive AI/GenAI initiatives (e.g., smart recommendation models, chat assistants, predictive routing) from proof-of-concept through to production and adoption.
  • Collaborative Formulation: Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and ML teams to define scope, execution plans, and success metrics.
  • AI Success Metrics: Track AI-specific performance metrics, including model accuracy, latency, reliability, token costs, and adoption.
  • Safety & Quality Guardrails: Ensure AI solutions consider privacy, data security, model quality, continuous monitoring, and graceful fallback mechanisms.
AI, Automation & Tooling (Internal Productivity)
  • Agile Tooling Innovation: Build or prototype lightweight tools, dashboards, automations, and AI-powered workflows to optimize program tracking.
  • Process Automation: Use AI to improve requirement analysis, risk detection, dependency tracking, reporting, and release readiness.
  • Eliminating Friction: Automate repetitive program and engineering workflows using APIs, scripting, AI tools, or low-code platforms.
  • Scalable Mechanisms: Identify manual operational processes that can be replaced with scalable automation.


Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Educational Background: Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related technical field.
  • Agile Foundation: Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, APIs, system integrations, testing, and release management.
  • Strategic Oversight: Strong program management skills across planning, execution, risk, dependency, and stakeholder management.
  • Technical Depth: Ability to understand technical architectures, microservices, and databases, working effectively alongside engineers and architects.
  • Professional Attributes: Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills; ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ownership Mindset: A clear bias toward execution, problem-solving, and measurable outcomes.
  • Tech Adaptability: Ability to quickly learn and adopt emerging technologies, including modern AI tools and frameworks.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Engineering Roots: Prior hands-on experience as an SDE, SDET, DevOps Engineer, Data Engineer, or a similar technical role.
  • Delivery History: 2+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience before or alongside transitioning into Program Management.
  • Program Diversity: Experience driving AI/ML, GenAI, Data, Platform, or Developer Productivity programs.
  • System Integration: Experience building internal tools, dashboards, JIRA automations, or productivity solutions.
  • Certifications: CSM, CSP, PMP, SAFe, or equivalent certification is a plus.


What Success Looks Like
A successful TPM at redBus acts as an operational anchor:
  • Predictable Velocity: Improves delivery predictability and release confidence (aiming for the target 90%100% performance band).
  • Proactive Mitigation: Identifies and resolves risks before they turn into blockers.
  • Backlog Maturity: Drives strong sprint and release readiness, ensuring zero features slip into development with open dependencies.
  • Quality Improvement: Drives down post-production defect leakage through early DevQA alignment.
  • Simplified Delivery: Simplifies complex, multi-team global cross-team execution.
  • AI Delivery: Successfully drives experimental AI initiatives into production.
  • Operational Leverage: Uses automation to reduce manual coordination and builds scalable mechanisms that dramatically improve engineering productivity.
At redBus, the TPM is expected to operate as a technical program leader, AI enabler, collaborative problem solver, and execution owner.

We support health providers by providing accessible, trusted evidence-based information; prepare more medical and nursing students with effective tools and resources; provide insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes; and supports a more personalized and localized healthcare experience. All for the benefit of every patient.
This role sits within the Sales Marketing Data Analytics team, part of the wider Digital Business Solutions (DBS) group. Our team provides the analytical foundations that drive two of Elseviers most revenue-critical functions: sales performance and marketing effectiveness.
On the Sales side, accurate and timely reporting is critical to incentivising and guiding our global sales force. Opportunities data warehouse provides analytics on salesperson pipeline, actual sales, and quota, and Agreements data warehouse provides analytics on sales agreements and renewals.
On the Marketing side, the Contacts data warehouse enables global marketing teams to design effective marketing campaigns with the desired segmentation for the business area and product they want to focus.
There are also some standalone datasets ingested from multiple sources, some are quite huge serving analytics needs for various data and analytical teams across the business.
You will be working on cutting-edge technology and helping with the latest companywide AI initiatives such as Spec-driven development within the Sales and Marketing squad.
About the Role:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Elsevier, you will be responsible for the technical design, delivery, and evolution of the Sales Marketing Data Analytics platform. The role owns the design of scalable data solutions, drives engineering best practices, mentors engineers, and partners with Product, Analytics, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality data products. The engineer is expected to work independently, influence technical direction across the squad, and lead complex initiatives from discovery through production.
Responsibilities
  • Lead architecture and technical design for data platforms, pipelines, and warehouse solutions.
  • Own delivery of complex initiatives from design through production support.
  • Design, build, and optimise scalable Snowflake and DBT data pipelines.
  • Define data models, performance standards, observability, and reliability practices.
  • Lead technical design reviews and establish engineering standards.
  • Champion code quality through reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Mentor engineers through pair programming, coaching, and technical guidance.
  • Partner with Product Owners, Analysts, and stakeholders to shape technical roadmaps.
  • Drive continuous improvement by reducing technical debt and improving platform performance.
  • Lead incident analysis, root-cause investigations, and reliability improvements.
  • Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies including AI-assisted engineering and specification-driven development where they provide measurable value.
Requirements
What Were Looking For
Beyond technical skills, we value engineers who bring:
  • Strong problem-solving ability - comfortable with ambiguous requirements and large, complex datasets
  • Clear communication - able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborative mindset - builds relationships across the business and works well in cross-functional teams
  • Technical ownership - takes pride in code quality, reliability, and continuous improvement
  • Curiosity and growth mindset - enthusiastic about learning, including emerging technologies such as AI and Spec-driven development
Experience Skills
Essential:
  • Significant professional experience designing and operating enterprise data warehouse solutions.
  • Expert knowledge of Snowflake, DBT, SQL, and dimensional data modelling.
  • Strong experience with AWS-based data platforms.
  • Experience building production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and Jenkins or equivalent.
  • Strong Python development skills for data engineering.
  • Experience leading technical delivery and mentoring engineers.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and ability to influence technical decisions.
  • Experience applying AI-assisted engineering or LLM-enabled developer tooling.
Desirable:
  • Working knowledge of AWS cloud services and Apache Airflow
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, particularly Terraform
  • Programming experience in Python and/or Java

jobDescription:
Property Treaty UW Advisor

Are you passionate about the science of risk? Do you thrive at the intersection of natural catastrophe modelling, reinsurance, and cutting-edge analytics? If you're ready to bring your expertise to a global stage and make a real impact on how the world manages risk, this could be the perfect next step in your career.

About the Role

Join Swiss Res Property Treaty Underwriting Advisory group in Bangalore as a Property Treaty UW Advisor. This is a rare opportunity to immerse yourself in the fast-paced, intellectually stimulating world of natural catastrophe reinsurance - working with Swiss Res proprietary risk modelling platforms and collaborating with underwriting desks across the globe. You'll play a pivotal role in shaping how risk is understood, priced, and managed for some of the world's most complex property portfolios.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality NatCat costing by analyzing property exposure data and providing underwriting advisory support to global underwriting desks
  • Model property portfolios using Swiss Res internal and external risk assessment tools, including Risk Link, MultiSnap, and GRP
  • Advise and guide underwriters in interpreting model results, understanding model differences, and navigating model limitations
  • Collaborate on benchmarking and pricing of reinsurance contracts, working closely with underwriters to develop robust costing solutions
  • Champion best practices in modelling and costing by continuously developing and applying the latest methodologies
  • Partner with the global underwriting community and business partners on projects that generate valuable services and insights for Swiss Res
  • Drive model improvement by leveraging findings from underwriting analyses to enhance NatCat models and tools
  • Build sophisticated analytics and client services by extracting meaningful insights from large and complex datasets

About the Team

The Property Treaty UW Advisory, APAC team is a specialist group dedicated to delivering high-quality underwriting analytics - with a primary focus on NatCat costing and occasional Fire costing - to various underwriting desks across Swiss Res Americas region. The team plays a critical role in enabling underwriters to make well-informed, data-driven decisions on complex reinsurance portfolios. Working at the heart of Swiss Res global risk assessment capabilities, the team combines deep technical expertise with a collaborative, client-focused approach to drive meaningful outcomes for the business.

About You

You are a curious, analytically driven professional who thrives in a complex, global environment. You bring a strong scientific foundation, a passion for problem-solving, and the ability to communicate sophisticated technical insights to diverse audiences. You take ownership of your work, embrace collaboration, and are motivated by the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing multiple priorities, and delivering high-quality results - even under pressure.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

  • University degree in a natural science or quantitative field such as Statistics, Engineering, or Earth Sciences
  • 3-5+ years of experience in the insurance or reinsurance industry, with strong knowledge of NatCat modelling and hands-on experience with CAT modelling tools such as RMS, AIR, or eqcat
  • Strong programming skills including proficiency in SQL, VBA, R, or Power BI for data analysis and model development
  • Deep understanding of insurance and reinsurance concepts, including treaty structures, exposure management, and pricing frameworks
  • Proven track record of delivering complex analytical results to internal or external clients in a clear, actionable manner

These are additional nice to haves:

  • An active interest in building and improving costing and pricing techniques for (re)insurance products
  • Demonstrated ability to lead or manage multiple projects simultaneously, including cross-functional collaboration
  • Familiarity with InsurTech trends, competitor analysis, and evolving insurance market dynamics
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills - both written and verbal - with the ability to engage confidently in a global, multicultural setting
  • A scientific and technological curiosity with a track record of bringing new ideas and constructively challenging the status quo

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

descriptionFromApi:
About the Role

project44s Global IT Services team is looking for an IT Automation Engineer to own the automation and integration backbone connecting our HR, Finance, Sales, and Security systems - while also building and running two business-critical internal platforms from the ground up. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable writing a Workato recipe, querying Snowflake, standing up a small internal application, and jumping into a helpdesk ticket or production incident when it matters.

What You'll Do

Systems Integration Business Process Automation

  • Own the Workato platform: build, monitor, and maintain the recipes, connections, and AI agents that automate cross-system business processes; triage and fix failed or runaway jobs
  • Co-own the HR-to-IT identity lifecycle, driving the UKG Pro Azure AD sync that powers joiner/leaver/employee-change automation, including edge cases and downstream SSO coordination
  • Maintain finance systems automation, including NetSuite Salesforce integrations
  • Own people-data and compliance pipelines, including the Culture Amp SFTP integration and the hybrid-work compliance pipeline feeding manager dashboards and Power BI
  • Serve as the go-to engineer for Retool app incidents that block Customer Success or Finance workflows

Build and Own Internal Platforms

  • Design, build, and operate project44s internal Project Registry - the system of record for every internal app, integration, dashboard, and AI component, along with its governance workflows
  • Design, build, and operate project44s AI/Claude spend governance platform - a business-critical system for monitoring and controlling company-wide Anthropic Claude spend, including data pipelines, dashboards, Slack bot workflows, and the policy engine behind it
  • Harden both systems for production use: rate limiting, kill switches, phased rollouts, and data-quality safeguards
  • Author architecture documentation and decision records to support review and long-term ownership

IT Support, Endpoint Security Compliance

  • Triage and resolve helpdesk, escalation, and offboarding tickets across SaaS and hardware requests
  • Build automation and scripts (PowerShell/Python) to collect endpoint compliance evidence for SOC 2 and third-party audits
  • Handle joiner/mover/leaver operations, including account terminations and identity-sync troubleshooting

SaaS, Identity Vendor Administration

  • Support major platform migrations (e.g., Slack Enterprise Grid)
  • Run security review and provisioning for new MCP servers and SaaS/AI tool requests in partnership with Security/InfoSec
  • Administer SSO/security configuration for vendor tools and troubleshoot integration issues
  • Periodically audit service accounts and credential usage for security reviews

What You'll Bring

Integration Automation

  • Experience with Workato (or a similar iPaaS): recipe design, webhooks, debugging
  • SQL and Snowflake experience (schemas, views, service accounts, performance/data-quality troubleshooting)
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and NetSuite data models and integration patterns
  • Experience with UKG Pro and Azure AD/Entra ID identity flows
  • Depth in Microsoft Entra ID: dynamic groups, Conditional Access, enterprise applications, SCIM/SAML provisioning
  • Azure hosting experience: Automation runbooks, Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, managed identities
  • Microsoft Intune / endpoint management and device compliance experience

Application Development / Low-Code

  • Experience with Retool for building and maintaining internal apps
  • Experience with Lovable or similar AI-assisted app builders
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and basic backend service design (auth, RBAC, rate limiting)
  • Azure fundamentals: Runbooks, Table Storage, Static Web Apps, storage/containers
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps

AI / LLM Operations

  • Hands-on experience with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or similar LLM platforms, including usage/cost monitoring and governance
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and standing up or reviewing MCP servers
  • Experience with Slack API/bot development (slash commands, DMs, interactive workflows)

IT Support, Security Compliance

  • Experience with Freshservice or a comparable ITSM/helpdesk platform
  • Endpoint management and security experience (e.g., Microsoft Defender)
  • SOC 2 or similar compliance audit support experience
  • Scripting for operations/automation: PowerShell and Python

Other

  • Power BI experience (report/dashboard consumption and troubleshooting)
  • GitHub and general version-control

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION Fox Corporation is home to industry-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, and Tubi Media Group. We combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world-class content to shape the future of digital entertainment. Our DTC platforms are built to deliver highly personalized, scalable user experiences to millions of global users.

ABOUT THE ROLE

FOX Corporation is looking for a SDE (L2), Android for its digital Product Engineering Client Android team. The candidate should have a strong working knowledge of Object Oriented Programming and native Android application development Skills.

At FOX, Android team builds and maintains applications for a variety of digital platforms using a number of technologies for multitude of FOXs consumer facing apps. Android team seeks a talented Android Application Engineer to join our team in developing, maintaining, optimizing and implementation of new features to our android application.

A qualified candidate should feel comfortable working with a broad range of Native application technologies, possess a strong working knowledge of Android Frameworks, be proficient in Object oriented/Java / kotlin programming, and be able to work with several internal teams and external partners. Should possess excellent debugging and problem-solving skills. Should be able to create functional applications that perfectly meet the needs of the product.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Influence the development of individual features and products, integrating best practices and patterns applicable to the Android engineering lifecycle

  • Take ownership of end-to-end product quality, from development to maintenance of core app, enhancing reliability and user experience

  • Prototype new ideas and explore cutting-edge technologies in mobile technology

  • Take ownership of scaling mobile app development efforts across Engineering, offering insights into refining processes and tools to support increased contributors in our architecture and code

  • Work collaboratively with team members and internal technology groups to focus on coding standards and best practices

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • At least 3-7 years of experience in working as an android developer.

  • BS/MS degree in computer science or software engineering

  • Proficient in building mobile applications and mobility solutions, particularly native applications

  • Mastery of basic Android components: Activity, Services, Intent, Broadcast Receiver, and Content Provider

  • Mastery of Kotlin concepts

  • Mastery of Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Flows, Jetpack components, Kotlinx Serialization

  • Strong experience with Web Service Integration (REST, JSON)

  • Experience with Performance, Testing Tooling

  • Experience with Security concept - Jetpack Security, encryption,Handling OAuth and secure token storage.

  • Experience with Modern Architecture : MVVM / MVI patterns using ViewModel, LiveData, Flow, or StateFlow.

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools - using Android Studio s Gemini or GitHub Copilot or Cursor

NICE TO HAVE (NOT MANDATORY)

  • Familiarity with video player frameworks

  • Experience developing applications for Fire TV and/or Android TV

descriptionFromApi:
Job Description

The Full Stack Engineer is a highly skilled individual contributor who builds high-quality software while contributing to technical direction within the team. This is a hands-on role focused on delivering scalable, maintainable solutions while supporting a culture of continuous improvement and collaborative delivery. As part of our AI-First Software Delivery (AIFSD) transformation, you will also contribute to evolving how software is built by leveraging AI to improve development speed, quality, and efficiency.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager or Tech Lead and plays a key part in delivering modern, cloud-based platforms that support our vision of a leading knowledge marketplace. This is an exciting time to join our established business as it undergoes a major transformation, driven by technology at the forefront of academic publishing.

Based in our Technology hub in Bangalore, we are looking for a dynamic, results-oriented Senior Full Stack Engineer who can make timely, pragmatic technical decisions, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term maintainability, and ensuring steady progress without unnecessary complexity.

Key Responsibilities

Software Development Technical Contribution

  • Write, review, and own production-quality code as an active contributor to the teams codebase; this is a technical, hands-on role
  • Champion the use of AI-first software delivery approaches, leveraging AI tools and frameworks to enhance development efficiency, automate repetitive tasks, and improve decision-making
  • Advocate for and implement modern engineering practices, such as Continuous Integration Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Contribute to architectural decisions at the team and system level, balancing pragmatism with long-term maintainability

Delivery Collaboration

  • Help break down complex technical work into well-scoped, deliverable increments
  • Contribute as a strong technical contributor within the team, supporting technical discussions and decisions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, including QAs, product owners, architects, designers, and program management to clarify requirements, surface constraints, and align technical solutions with business goals
  • Work closely with the Architecture Advice Forum through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to contribute to cross-team technical strategy, championing evolutionary architecture principles
  • Remove technical blockers and escalate risks early to protect team delivery commitments
  • Balance delivery pace with technical health - advocating for investment in test coverage, refactoring, and debt reduction

Quality Engineering Excellence

  • Champion test-driven development (TDD), behaviour-driven development (BDD), and automated testing at all levels
  • Collaborate with platform teams to establish CI/CD pipelines and automate deployment processes
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code using tools like Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning and management
  • Ensure robust monitoring, logging, and alerting systems are in place to maintain system reliability and performance
  • Promote security-by-design and advocate for responsible handling of data and infrastructure
  • Communication and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts, challenges, and solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Participate in cross-functional discussions with stakeholders
  • Build trust with internal stakeholders through transparency about risk, progress, and technical decisions
    Qualifications

Skills Experience

3+ years of professional software development experience.

  • Deep expertise in at least one modern programming language - JavaScript/Java with strong working knowledge of frontend/backend frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and principles (e.g., SOLID, microservices, event-driven architectures)
  • Experience with AI tools, frameworks, platforms, and their application in software delivery
  • Experience with cloud platforms (especially AWS services), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks
  • Familiarity with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and data modelling
  • Fluency with XP practices: TDD, pair programming, continuous integration, refactoring
  • Working knowledge of security principles (secrets management, least privilege)

title: GRC - Associate Manager
jobDescription:
Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. Advancing new ideas every day to build even stronger clients, individuals and communities. We re helping our clients find new ways to drive growth, enhance business performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. And, we re developing strategies and implementing solutions that enable the transformative change they need to own their future.

As a member of the Huron corporate team, you ll help to evolve our business model to stay ahead of market forces, industry trends and client needs. Our accounting, finance, human resources, IT, legal, marketing and facilities management professionals work collaboratively to support Huron s collective strategies and enable real transformation to produce sustainable business results.

Join our team and create your future.

Under limited direction, this individual is responsible for managing projects for Huron s growing corporate IT Security and GRC teams. The individual would be responsible for driving various security and GRC projects initiatives and liaising with technical and business groups to gather requirements, manage projects, and promote compliance and security best practices. This role requires the candidate to work collaboratively with various corporate teams and lines of business. As this role necessitates communication within and across time zones, excellent verbal and written communication is required. The individual should be dynamic, a quick learner, and should also have excellent presentation skills.

Requirements:
- Manage and deliver GRC projects impacting enterprise-scale software products subject to regulatory requirements including HIPAA, CCPA, GDPR, FedRAMP and ISO 27000 series and SOC audits.
- Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders across security, engineering, legal, compliance, privacy, and internal audit teams to ensure on-time completion of projects and initiatives.
- Create, maintain and update control documentation, standard operating procedures, and compliance artifacts in accordance with organizational standards.
- Assist in the implementation and ongoing management of enterprise GRC tools and workflows.
- Create, Manage and track project plans, project milestones, compliance metrics and risk indicators; prepare reports and dashboards for senior leadership and governance committees.
- Partner with product and engineering teams to integrate security and privacy requirements into Software/System development lifecycles (SDLC).
- Ensure readiness for internal and external audits through structured planning, documentation management, and stakeholder engagement.
- Monitor regulatory and framework updates, escalating impacts, and coordinating required changes across the organization.

Preferences:
- Bachelor s degree along with PMP certification required or advanced academic degree in Project Management.
- 4-6 years of experience in GRC, IT compliance, risk management, or security-focused project/program management within an enterprise organization.
- Demonstrated experience supporting compliance and governance initiatives involving PHI, PII; federal frameworks such as FedRAMP and the use of AI across business functions.
- Working knowledge of audit and certification processes, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
- Familiarity with enterprise control frameworks (ISO 27000 series, NIST, etc.).
- Experience managing projects with defined methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches).
- Experience with tools and leveraging AI to complete tasks (i.e., Smartsheet, MS Project/SharePoint, ADO, etc).
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams in a structured environment.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, experience navigating complex organizational structures.
- Experience operating within cloud-based enterprise environments (e.g., AWS, Azure)
- Familiarity with privacy program operations, including DPIAs.
- Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and map them to technical and operational controls.
- Experience supporting audit interactions with external auditors and internal audit functions in a structured environment.
- Security certification(s) from ISC2, SANS, Offensive Security, TCM Security, ISACA, other known certification authority.

Position Level Manager

Country India

Job Title

Data Scientist II - Commercialization EF DS AI Solutions

Job Summary

The Data Scientist II role is a high-impact idea generator and deep problem solver within analytics team. This role is for individuals who can challenge assumptions, conceptualize novel analytical approaches, and harness emerging technologies to deliver transformative business solutions. This role is designed for an experienced data scientist with strong time-series forecasting expertise who can independently own end-to-end forecasting workstreams, improve and scale enterprise forecasting platforms, and lead initiatives that directly influence commercial and strategic decision-making.

This individual operates with a high degree of autonomy, translating ambiguous business problems into robust forecasting solutions, partnering closely with Finance, Commercial, Market Access, and Analytics stakeholders. The role blends deep technical execution, platform thinking, and stakeholder leadership

Responsibilities

  • Ideate, architect, and prototype high-impact analytical and ML/AI solutions.
  • Break down ambiguous business problems into clear, scalable analytical workflows.
  • Design, develop, and maintain advanced forecasting models using statistical, machine learning, and AI-driven approaches across commercial demand and planning use cases.
  • Partner with stakeholders to frame hypotheses, define KPIs, and design experiment frameworks.
  • Explore and analyse large structured and unstructured datasets from clinical, digital, and real-world sources.
  • Apply advanced ML, statistical methods, and LLM-based techniques to generate business solutions.
  • Work with engineering teams to ensure reliable data pipelines and deployment environments.
  • Present complex model logic and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI/ML and agentic-system tools to future-proof capabilities.
  • Mentor junior data scientists and promote a culture of experimentation and innovation.
  • Apply MLOps best practices including version control, reproducibility, model monitoring, and documentation.

Experience

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in applied ML and problem-solving roles.
  • Experience working with large structured/unstructured datasets (SQL, NoSQL, document stores).
  • Demonstrated success building predictive or AI models with measurable business impact.
  • Experience with healthcare, clinical trials, or regulated pharma datasets (preferred).
  • Strong hold on MLOps tools: MLflow, Git, CI/CD, containerization.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong hands-on expertise in Python-based data science and analytical workflows.
  • Strong foundations in statistics, hypothesis testing, and experimental design.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder-influence abilities.
  • Solid experience in time-series forecasting (ARIMA, Prophet, Holt-Winters); multivariate and hierarchical forecasting is a plus.
  • Experience with AWS/Azure/GCP and modern data ecosystems (Spark, Databricks, BigQuery, Snowflake).
  • Comfortable navigating fast-paced, ambiguous problem environments with autonomy.
  • Strong foundations in experimentation, causal inference, and hypothesis-driven analysis.
  • Advanced visualization skills using Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib, seaborn, or Plotly.
  • Solid understanding of agentic AI architectures and autonomous or semi-autonomous analytical agents.

Good to Have

  • Experience enhancing or scaling enterprise level platforms.
  • Exposure to AI-augmented or LLM-assisted analytics workflows applied to planning or forecasting use cases.
  • Ability to prototype autonomous agents that handle multi-step or decision-making workflows.
  • Familiarity with tool-calling, orchestration, and autonomous reasoning toolkits.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM projects or participation in relevant hackathons.

On-site Protocol

BMS has an occupancy structure that determines where an employee is required to conduct their work. This structure includes site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design jobs. The occupancy type that you are assigned is determined by the nature and responsibilities of your role.

Job Summary

Were building the AI engine behind root cause analysis for a platform that supports over 100 enterprise customers - this role owns everything from the vector database to the confidence scoring that decides whether an engineer gets notified automatically or a human steps in.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain embedding pipelines that convert operational documents into searchable vector representations, selecting embedding models and designing chunking strategies for structured JSON, unstructured prose, and time-series data types.
  • Build the RAG retrieval layer that runs at incident time, tuning relevance thresholds, re-ranking strategies, and hybrid (dense and sparse) search to surface the most contextually relevant documents per collection.
  • Design the full ingestion lifecycle, including runbook imports, historical incident backfill, CI/CD post-deploy event hooks, and the feedback loop that embeds resolved incidents back into the vector database.
  • Design and iterate the prompt that assembles Grafanas stateless RCA, live signal data, and RAG-retrieved context into a single input, instructing Claude to reason across evidence types and produce a structured, actionable RCA readable in under 30 seconds.
  • Define and maintain the JSON schema for RCA output (root cause, confidence score, contributing factors, immediate actions, SLA impact, precedent reference, escalation path) and build the Pydantic validation layer that catches schema violations before delivery.
  • Own the calibrated 0-1 confidence scoring framework weighting RAG precedent strength, signal consistency, deployment correlation, runbook recognition, root cause specificity, and customer context fit, and build the FastAPI gate logic that routes RCAs to the correct action tier.
  • Maintain a golden test set of 20-30 historical incidents and run the full pipeline against it after every prompt or RAG change, using a judge-prompt approach to score accuracy and catch regressions.
  • Run monthly calibration checks comparing confidence scores against SRE-confirmed outcomes, calculating Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and adjusting thresholds accordingly.
  • Build a prompt versioning system with changelog tracking, and monitor token usage, cost per RCA, and API latency, alerting on unexpected cost trends.
  • Track retrieval quality metrics including relevance scores, coverage gaps, cross-tenant isolation verification, and ablation testing of RCA quality with and without each data collection.

Requirements

  • Strong Python skills, including FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, and async patterns.

As a Staff Software Engineer, youll help lead two important areas for GitLab Security: the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities, and our move toward services outside the GitLab monolith. Youll design and develop systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab.

Youll take ownership of large deliverables from early ideas through implementation, working directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to shape the technical and product roadmap. Youll stay hands-on across GitLabs Ruby on Rails application and newer services, including greenfield projects, while helping the team build its expertise in modular service design.

  • Lead large technical deliverables from initial problem definition through delivery, often across multiple months or quarters.
  • Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems.
  • Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate.
  • Shape technical plans, break down complex work, and help other engineers deliver effectively.
  • Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress.
  • Influence the teams product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle.
  • Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages.
  • Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security.

What you ll bring

  • Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development.
  • Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log management in data-intensive systems.
  • Strong professional experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, or Python, and comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day. Experience with large monoliths is helpful, along with an interest in working across languages and services.
  • Experience shaping delivery plans, guiding technical decisions, and supporting the work of other engineers.
  • The ability to collaborate with a range of partners and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
  • Experience communicating with leaders, leading peers through complex delivery, identifying constraints, and moving work forward.

The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLabs move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. Youll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab.

We work with clear goals and shared priorities. Youll receive clear context and outcomes, then have the space to own delivery, communicate decisions and progress, ask for help early, and work directly with the partners needed to get the job done.

title: Sr Data Scientist
jobDescription:
At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether its medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build and own machine learning models that power core prediction problems across the FourKites platform - including ETA/ATA forecasting and message-based status extraction. You will work end-to-end, from data pipeline to production deployment and monitoring, turning noisy real-world logistics data into models that run at scale and directly move the needle on customer outcomes. You will work closely with product, engineering, and operations teams, hands-on building and shipping models yourself while also guiding the technical direction of other data scientists on the team.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design, build, and productionize ML models for problems like ETA/ATA prediction, using regression, classification, and time-series forecasting techniques
  • Develop NLP/LLM-based extraction pipelines for message-based ETA and status updates (text extraction, entity recognition)
  • Own models end-to-end: data pipeline training deployment monitoring retraining
  • Work with noisy, real-world logistics and supply chain data (GPS pings, check calls, carrier data) rather than clean, pre-processed datasets
  • Diagnose gaps between offline evaluation performance and live production accuracy, and drive fixes
  • Build and maintain automated training/retraining pipelines using orchestration tools such as Airflow
  • Set up and maintain model monitoring and observability (e.g., Grafana) to catch drift and degradation proactively
  • Replace manual or rule-based processes with ML-driven automation (e.g., automating manual check calls)
  • Translate model performance improvements into business impact - operational savings, efficiency gains, and deal-relevant outcomes
  • Mentor and guide other data scientists/engineers on technical approach and best practices
  • Make build-vs-buy and architecture tradeoff decisions independently

Who you are:

  • Strong ML fundamentals across regression, classification, and time-series forecasting
  • NLP experience - text extraction, entity recognition, or LLM-based extraction
  • Production ML experience - youve shipped models serving real traffic, not just built POCs or notebooks
  • Strong Python and SQL skills - pandas, scikit-learn, and comfort querying large datasets (Redshift/Snowflake a plus)
  • Experience with cloud and data infrastructure - AWS (S3, EC2), and orchestration tools like Airflow for training/retraining pipelines
  • Experience setting up or working with model monitoring and observability tooling (Grafana or similar)
  • Comfortable working with noisy, real-world data rather than clean, curated datasets
  • Experience diagnosing and closing the gap between offline evaluation results and live production performance
  • A track record of replacing manual/rule-based processes with ML solutions
  • Ability to translate model output into business value and communicate that impact to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations teams
  • Experience mentoring or guiding other data scientists or engineers
  • Ability to make build-vs-buy and architecture tradeoffs independently
  • A track record of reducing manual intervention or turnaround time through automation
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

Nice to have:

  • Experience in logistics, supply chain, or transportation
  • Familiarity with real-time/streaming data (Kafka)
  • Exposure to LLM/GenAI applications in production

jobDescription:

Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Role purpose

The Core Applications team is doing greenfield work, introducing new concepts and capabilities to our suite of UI products on a modern React + TypeScript stack.

As a Senior Software Engineer, youll own significant portions of the codebase, drive technical decisions, and mentor fellow engineers. Youll collaborate closely with a distributed team across Australia and the US. This is a high-ownership role on a small, self-organizing team with direct visibility into a major product milestone.

How you contribute

  • Build and ship features on the new agent desktop in React + TypeScript + Nx, using AI coding agents as part of the daily workflow.
  • Review and approve pull requests and provide constructive feedback that raises overall application quality.
  • Mentor fellow engineers and help set the technical bar for the team.
  • Collaborate async-first with engineering, product, and design across distributed time zones.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and async planning via written documentation, Jira, and Confluence.

Skills, competencies and qualifications

Required:

  • Strong React and TypeScript proficiency; experience with other modern frameworks (Vue, Angular, Svelte) is a good signal.
  • Testing experience with Jest and/or Playwright, with an understanding of the value of thorough test coverage.
  • Able to operate autonomously on a small, fast-paced team; fills gaps and makes reasonable calls without constant direction.
  • Strong written communication and collaboration skills for a remote, async-first, distributed environment.
  • Comfortable conducting code reviews, providing constructive feedback, and mentoring less experienced engineers.
  • Prior experience using AI coding tools and a genuine willingness to evolve those skills as the space changes.
  • Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline.

Desirable:

  • Prior experience in CCaaS, agent desktop, or UI platform roles.

  • Web accessibility knowledge; familiarity with WCAG standards and building accessible UIs.
  • Monorepo and micro-frontend architecture experience; Nx preferred, but PNPM, Lerna, and other tools are good signals.
  • Experience with WebSockets or real-time application development.

Other requirements

  • Working shift must be aligned to overlap with Pacific working hours.
  • This position requires the ability to be On Call.

Key relationships

There are no direct reports to this role.

Key stakeholders include:

  • Engineering teams

Maximize Your Impact with TP
Welcome to TP, a global hub of innovation and empowerment, where we redefine the future. With a remarkable 10 billion annual revenue and a global team of 500,000 employees serving 170 countries in over 300 languages, we lead in intelligent, digital-first solutions.

As a Great Place to Work certified in 72 countries, our culture thrives on diversity, equity, and inclusion. We value your unique perspective and believe that your talent is the missing piece that completes our vision for a brighter, digitally driven tomorrow.

The Opportunity
The Junior Solution Architect - Digital Transformation, AI CX supports the conversion of client business, operational, and technology needs into structured, viable end-to-end solutions aligned with TP capabilities.

The role participates in discovery, pre-sales, proposals, and early project definition, working under the guidance of senior Solution Architects and coordinating information from Sales, Consulting, Transformation, Product, Data, AI, Software Engineering, Operations, Cybersecurity, and technology partners.

The position combines analytical thinking, functional and technical understanding, documentation capability, and client orientation. The individual is expected to understand problems, structure requirements, produce solution artifacts, analyze alternatives, and contribute to estimates, demos, and handovers while progressively developing architectural judgment and autonomy.

The Responsibilities
  • Support discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to understand objectives, processes, customer journeys, pain points, volumes, channels, data, applications, integrations, and constraints.
  • Prepare agendas, questions, background information, and working materials for functional and technical workshops.
  • Document needs, high-level functional and non-functional requirements, assumptions, dependencies, risks, decisions, and open questions.
  • Contribute to operational and technology baselines and connect problems with transformation opportunities.
  • Maintain traceability among the client need, expected outcomes, and proposed solution components.
  • Support the design of end-to-end solutions integrating processes, people, channels, data, platforms, AI, automation, and integrations.
  • Create and maintain solution blueprints, context diagrams, information flows, functional views, component catalogs, and integration matrices.
  • Organize contributions from AI, Data, Cloud, Software, Security, CX, and Operations specialists into a coherent solution.
  • Analyze solution alternatives and document benefits, limitations, dependencies, and trade-offs for senior architect review.
  • Verify consistency across requirements, conceptual solution, scope, assumptions, and proposed deliverables.
  • Use TP standards, templates, reference architectures, and approved patterns.
  • Support RFP/RFI responses, proposals, solutioning workshops, and executive and technical presentations.
  • Contribute to the value proposition, storyline, and functional and technical description of the solution.
  • Prepare supporting materials, diagrams, compliance matrices, technical responses, and documentation for internal and client reviews.
  • Coordinate pending information and actions with Sales, Consulting, specialists, partners, and vendors.
  • Support demos, proofs of concept, and proofs of value by documenting scenarios, dependencies, and success criteria.
  • Participate in client presentations and progressively build the capability to explain and defend assigned solution components.
  • Support the definition of scope, work packages, deliverables, exclusions, assumptions, and dependencies.
  • Collect and consolidate estimates from Transformation, Engineering, Data, AI, Operations, vendors, and partners.
  • Verify that estimates are traceable to solution components and activities.
  • Document assumptions related to volumes, users, concurrency, channels, storage, licensing, model consumption, infrastructure, and support.
  • Contribute to the Bill of Materials, cost structure, and pricing models under supervision.
  • Identify inconsistencies, omissions, or risks that may affect effort, schedule, cost, or viability and escalate them promptly.
  • Research platforms, products, vendors, and capabilities applicable to each opportunity.
  • Compare build, buy, configure, reuse, or partner alternatives using architecture-team criteria.
  • Identify reusable TP assets, products, accelerators, and capabilities.
  • Prepare comparative matrices covering capabilities, licensing, integrations, support, security, scalability, and constraints.
  • Maintain current references, components, and vendor information used by the solutioning team.
  • Escalate findings or risks related to vendor lock-in, roadmaps, cost, compliance, or third-party dependency.
  • Prepare and support the pre-sales-to-delivery handover, ensuring documentation is complete, current, and organized.
  • Maintain traceability for architecture, scope, assumptions, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and pending decisions.
  • Participate in kickoffs, solution-refinement sessions, and design reviews as required.
  • Update solution artifacts based on approved decisions or changes during early project stages.
  • Identify differences between the sold solution and delivery interpretation and facilitate resolution with the accountable architect.
  • Capture project lessons to improve future blueprints, proposals, templates, and estimates.
  • Support the definition of baselines, KPIs, success criteria, and value hypotheses.
  • Connect solution components with business, operational, experience, and efficiency outcomes.
  • Contribute to basic business cases and benefit models with Consulting, Sales, Operations, and Finance.
  • Maintain a record of value assumptions and metrics to be validated during delivery.
  • Support identification of expansion or reuse opportunities based on existing solutions.
  • Include defined security, privacy, identity, segregation, residency, and data-retention requirements in solution artifacts.
  • Coordinate questions and evidence required by Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance.
  • Identify basic risks related to data, integrations, third parties, operational continuity, and AI use, and escalate them to the accountable owner.
  • Apply Responsible AI, human-oversight, guardrail, and information-protection checklists and standards where applicable.
  • Verify that risks, exceptions, and open decisions are documented and assigned to an owner.
  • Complete the defined learning path across CX, BPO, architecture, cloud, AI, data, automation, and consulting.
  • Request feedback and apply lessons from proposal, design, and project reviews.
  • Contribute to playbooks, templates, knowledge bases, demos, and reusable team assets.
  • Participate in communities of practice, technical sessions, and architecture reviews.
  • Progressively develop autonomy to lead low-complexity opportunities and defined components of larger solutions.

  • At least 2-3 years participating in solutioning, architecture, business analysis, consulting, pre-sales, or client-facing technical roles.
  • Experience documenting requirements, processes, integrations, or functional and technical designs.
  • Participation in proposals, RFP/RFI responses, estimates, demos, proofs of concept, or transformation projects.

Production AI Needs More Than Models: Why Enterprise Infrastructure Is Becoming the New Competitive Advantage

Enterprise AI has entered a new phase.

For the past two years, organizations have focused on experimentation testing copilots, evaluating foundation models, building proofs of concept, and exploring new use cases. Public cloud played a critical role in enabling this wave of innovation, providing rapid access to compute, models, and AI services.

But production AI is fundamentally different from AI experimentation.

When AI becomes embedded in business operations, customer experiences, internal workflows, and decision-making systems, infrastructure choices become strategic business decisions. Questions about cost, governance, data ownership, integration, and operational control move from the IT department to the boardroom.

Recent research from Broadcom s Private Cloud Outlook 2026 highlights this shift. Based on a survey of 1,800 senior IT decision-makers worldwide, the report found that 56% of organizations are running or planning to run production AI inference in private cloud environments, while public cloud use for production inference declined from 56% to 41% year over year.

The message is not that public cloud is disappearing.

The message is that enterprises are becoming far more intentional about where AI workloads run and why.

At Kirk Tech Solutions, we believe this represents a larger transition:

The next phase of enterprise AI will be defined not only by access to models, but by ownership of the infrastructure, data, governance, and operations that make AI work at scale.

AI Is Becoming an Infrastructure Challenge

The first generation of enterprise AI projects often focused on models:

  • Which LLM should we use
  • Should we use a hosted API or open-weight models
  • Which AI platform is best

These remain important questions.

But as organizations move from pilots to production, new questions emerge:

  • How do we control infrastructure costs
  • Where does enterprise data reside
  • How do we govern AI systems
  • How do we integrate AI into existing operations
  • How do we scale securely

These are infrastructure questions.

Broadcom s research suggests that enterprises are already adjusting. Security, cost predictability, performance, sovereignty requirements, and operational control are increasingly influencing workload-placement decisions.

This shift is particularly important for AI inference.

Unlike experimentation, production inference can create sustained demand for compute, storage, networking, GPUs, monitoring, security, and data movement. AI systems often operate against sensitive information and become integrated into business-critical processes.

As AI moves deeper into operations, enterprises need more than models.

They need production-ready infrastructure.

The Economics of AI Are Changing Cloud Strategy

One of the most significant findings in the Broadcom report is the growing concern around cloud economics.

For the first time, cost overtook security as the top public cloud challenge. The report found that 97% of IT leaders believe some portion of their public cloud spending is wasted, and more than half estimate that waste exceeds 25% of total cloud spend.

AI amplifies this challenge.

Inference workloads increase demand for:

  • GPU capacity
  • High-performance storage
  • Data transfer
  • Network bandwidth
  • Security tooling
  • Observability platforms
  • Model serving infrastructure

The issue is not that public cloud lacks value. Public cloud remains highly effective for experimentation, elastic workloads, and specialized services.

However, enterprises are increasingly evaluating whether sustained AI workloads require a different operating model one that offers greater predictability and tighter alignment between infrastructure investment and business outcomes.

This is one reason workload repatriation is accelerating.

Broadcom found that 50% of enterprises have already moved some workloads from public cloud to private environments, while 33% are considering repatriation meaning 83% have either already repatriated workloads or are considering doing so. Notably, AI training, large language models, and inference appeared as a repatriation category for the first time in the 2026 research.

This is not a rejection of public cloud.

It is the emergence of a workload-centric strategy: placing each workload where it performs best economically, operationally, and securely.

Data Sovereignty Is Becoming an AI Requirement

AI introduces another challenge that extends beyond infrastructure economics: control.

AI systems increasingly interact with:

  • Customer information
  • Financial data
  • Intellectual property
  • Operational systems
  • Internal knowledge repositories
  • Regulated data

As organizations deploy AI into core business processes, they need visibility into:

  • Where data resides
  • Who can access it
  • Where models execute
  • How information moves
  • Which policies apply

Broadcom found that data sovereignty and residency requirements are now the leading geopolitical factor influencing IT strategy, cited by 54% of respondents. Four out of five IT leaders say geopolitical and regulatory concerns are affecting infrastructure decisions.

This is particularly relevant as enterprises move toward agentic AI systems capable of accessing tools, triggering workflows, and interacting with business applications.

Governance cannot be an afterthought.

It must be built into the architecture from the beginning.

Where FlatClaw Fits Into the Private AI Equation

As enterprise AI evolves from chatbots to AI coworkers and agentic systems, infrastructure becomes increasingly important. These systems can access enterprise knowledge, work with files, interact with applications, invoke tools, and automate workflows.

AI is no longer simply generating answers it can become part of how the enterprise operates. That makes data, security, governance, cost, and infrastructure ownership strategic considerations.

FlatClaw: Private AI Built for Enterprise Control

FlatClaw Private AI Coworker Platform is an open-source, private-cloud platform designed for private, single-tenant deployments within a customer s dedicated environment.

Its architecture emphasizes:

  • Customer-owned cloud deployment
  • Dedicated cloud or bare-metal infrastructure
  • Single-tenant architecture
  • Dedicated GPU infrastructure
  • Predictable infrastructure economics
  • Data remaining within the customer s environment
  • Persistent organizational AI memory
  • Enterprise integrations and RBAC
  • Open, auditable frameworks

FlatClaw also supports integrations such as Google Workspace and Jira, along with custom MCP protocols.

From AI Consumption to AI Ownership

As AI becomes more deeply embedded in enterprise operations, organizations need to think beyond model subscriptions and API consumption.

They need to ask:

Who controls the infrastructure, data, deployment, compute, economics, and auditability of their AI

From intimate salons and high-trust retreats to access to capital and exclusive opportunities, Griffin offers a curated path to clarity, collaboration, and personal growth. More than a community, it s the inner circle powering the next wave of industry-shaping leaders.

Job Overview
  • At Griffin, communication is not content creation - it is trust-building at the highest level.
  • As the Communication Lead, Griffin Club, you will own the voice, narrative, and communication engine of one of India s most exclusive founder collectives. This role sits at the intersection of brand, founder relationships, government engagement, member communication, event communication, and institutional storytelling.
  • You will work closely with the Founder s Office and Griffin leadership to ensure that every message going out of Griffin - whether to a unicorn founder, a minister s office, a public-market leader, a global institution, a member, a partner, or an internal team - feels sharp, thoughtful, premium, and worthy of the Griffin room.
  • This is not a conventional communications role. You are not just writing posts, invites, emails, or updates. You are helping shape how India s most consequential founders are spoken to, how Griffin is perceived, and how high-trust relationships are built through language, nuance, discretion, and speed.
  • This role is built for someone with exceptional writing ability, strong judgment, high ownership, and a deep bias for action.

  • Shape Griffin s Voice: Define and maintain the communication tone for Griffin across founder outreach, member updates, event invites, government notes, institutional communication, and brand narratives.
  • Work With India s Top Founders: Write and manage communication for a private room of unicorn, soonicorn, IPO-bound, and listed company founders.
  • Drive High-Stakes Outreach: Support communication with founders, investors, government offices, embassies, public-market leaders, institutions, and strategic partners.
  • Build Founder-First Narratives: Translate Griffin s work into crisp, sharp, emotionally intelligent communication that feels premium, private, and high-signal.
  • Power Griffin Events Experiences: Own communication before, during, and after Griffin Salons, Retreats, IPO Dialogues, international delegations, private dinners, and institutional engagements.
  • Create Speed With Quality: Build systems, templates, message banks, briefing notes, follow-ups, and communication processes that help Griffin move faster without losing nuance.

1. Griffin Brand Communication
  • Own Griffin s written voice across all key external and internal touchpoints.
  • Build and maintain Griffin s communication principles, tone guidelines, messaging banks, and standard templates.
  • Draft sharp and premium communication for Griffin announcements, member introductions, founder stories, event positioning, post-event notes, and institutional narratives.
  • Ensure all Griffin communication feels discreet, founder-first, high-trust, and never mass-market or sales-led.
  • Work closely with the design and events teams to ensure that visual communication and written communication feel aligned.
  • Support website copy, brochure copy, event collateral, invite text, membership communication, and presentation narratives.
2. Founder Outreach Prospect Communication
  • Draft founder outreach messages, warm introductions, follow-ups, membership notes, and invite communication.
  • Personalise communication for high-value founders depending on their company stage, sector, public profile, and relationship context.
  • Support communication for new member onboarding, application follow-ups, renewal conversations, and membership value communication.
  • Create crisp founder briefs and context notes before important calls or meetings.
  • Ensure founder-facing communication is thoughtful, respectful, direct, and never generic.
  • Maintain a bank of high-quality outreach formats for different founder segments - listed founders, IPO-bound founders, unicorn founders, exited founders, global founders, and ecosystem leaders.
3. Member Communication
  • Own regular member-facing communication across WhatsApp, email, event invites, updates, reminders, thank-you notes, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Draft new member introductions for the Griffin WhatsApp group in a sharp, credible, and premium format.
  • Write birthday notes, milestone notes, congratulatory messages, founder achievements, IPO updates, funding updates, and other member moments.
  • Ensure every member touchpoint feels personal, considered, and aligned with the stature of the room.
  • Work with the team to maintain updated member profiles, founder context, communication history, and relationship notes.
  • Support renewal communication by helping articulate value delivered to members over the year.
4. Event Communication
  • Own communication for Griffin Retreats, Salons, IPO Dialogues, private dinners, institutional rooms, international delegations, and closed-door founder gatherings.
  • Draft event save-the-dates, invitations, agenda notes, speaker invites, moderator briefs, attendee notes, reminders, and post-event thank-you messages.

  • Work closely with the events and operations teams to ensure communication is timely, accurate, and aligned with event flow.

  • Capture post-event highlights and convert them into founder-safe summaries, internal notes, and premium archival material.

  • Write in a tone that is diplomatic, polished, respectful, and appropriate for senior stakeholders.
  • Help position Griffin as a credible soft-power platform for India s leading technology founders.
  • Maintain communication quality for institutional engagements in India and abroad.
  • Ensure sensitive communication is handled with discretion, context, and maturity.
6. Content Systems, Documentation Communication Infrastructure
  • Build Griffin s internal communication repository - message banks, invite templates, founder introduction formats, thank-you notes, government note formats, event copy formats, and briefing structures.

  • Work closely with the Founder s Office, events team, design team, partnerships team, finance team, and leadership team.
  • Convert inputs from different stakeholders into clear, sharp, action-ready communication.
  • Push for clarity wherever needed - audience, objective, tone, timing, CTA, and follow-up.
  • Ensure communication is not created in isolation but supports Griffin s broader goals across acquisition, retention, experience, access, partnerships, and brand.
  • Be proactive in identifying communication gaps before they become execution gaps.

  • Exceptional Writing Ability: You can write with clarity, elegance, sharpness, and restraint. You know the difference between premium communication and verbose communication.

jobDescription:
Position Summary...

What youll do...

About Team:

If you re thinking scale , think bigger and don t stop there. At Walmart Labs Bengaluru, we don t just innovate, we enable transformations across stores and different channels for the Walmart experience. Take a regular day at Walmart Labs and match that with 260 million customers a week, 11,695 stores, under 59 banners in 28 countries and e-commerce websites in 11 countries. That s Walmart Labs Bengaluru for you.

Personalization team at Walmart is dedicated to the mission of knowing our customers better and making it frictionless and faster for them to get what they want while building a trusted partnership with Walmart. We help bring a seamless experience to our customers irrespective of how and where they engage with us - while shopping online and picking groceries at stores. We thrive to provide each customer with a journey tailored to their individual needs, preferences and routines. We operate at the intersection of huge Walmart assortment, millions of customers, thousands of stores and Walmart associates - a multi-layer multi-objective problem space which has a unique impact on Global consumer base and powers assisted AI for our associates.

The Personalization team consists of data scientists, application engineers, big data geeks and product visionaries all working together to design, prototype and build technology-driven products and experiences that will change the future landscape of e-commerce. We are focussed on building an intelligent system that will enable 1:1 personalised customer experience, from finding the product to delivering it to the customer. We are building state-of-the-art machine learnt systems using cutting edge technology that has ability to A/B test in fast iterations, use GPU/CPU based online inferencing of deep learnt and traditional models, event driven architecture that serves personalized experience for customers. This will span many markets, business models and form factors, therefore, we are looking for engineers and data scientists who will being not only an abundance of experiences in technologies but an abundant curiosity to innovate.

Also, The data science community at Walmart Labs is active in most of the Hack events, utilizing the petabytes of data at our disposal, to build some of the coolest ideas. All the work we do at Walmart Labs benefits our operations our associates, helping Customers Save Money to Live Better.

What youll do:

  • Apply and/or develop statistical modeling techniques (such as deep neural networks and Bayesian models), optimization methods and other ML techniques.
  • Develop efficient and scalable models at Walmart scale.
  • Collaborate with counterparts in business, engineering and science to find impactful solutions to business problems.
  • Define and/or own the model goodness metrics and track the business impact over time.
  • Present recommendations from complex analysis to business partners in clear and actionable form, influencing the future plans.
  • Manage the continuous improvement of data science and machine learning by following industry best practices and staying up-to-date with and extending the state-of-the-art in Machine Learning Research.
  • Integrate data science solutions into current business processes.
  • Develop and recommend process standards and best practices in Machine Learning as applicable to the retail industry.
  • Consult with business stakeholders across stores and e-commerce businesses regarding algorithm-based recommendations and be a thought-leader to develop these into business actions.
  • Participate and speak at various external forums such as research conferences and technical summits.
  • Promote and support company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity

What youll bring:

  • Bachelors with > 2 years of relevant experience OR Masters with > 1 years of relevant experience OR PHD in Comp Science/Statistics/Mathematics with >1 years of relevant experience
  • Experience in machine learning, supervised and unsupervised: NLP, Classification, Data/Text Mining, Multi-modal models, Neural Networks, Deep Learning Algorithms
  • Embedding generation from training materials, storage and retrieval from Vector Databases, set-up and provisioning of managed LLM gateways, development of Retrieval augmented generation based LLM agents, model selection, prompt engineering and finetuning based on accuracy and user-feedback, monitoring and governance.
  • Strong Experience in Python, PySpark,Google Cloud platform, model deployment
  • Strong Experience with big data platforms

About Walmart Global Tech
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the world s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.

Walmart s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, pto, health benefits, and much more.

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." by fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

Equal opportunity employer

Walmart, inc., is an equal opportunities employer - by choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

Minimum Qualifications...

Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no minimum qualifications.

Minimum Qualifications:Option 1: Bachelors degree in Statistics, Economics, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field and 2 years experience in an analytics or related field. Option 2: Masters degree in Statistics, Economics, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field. Option 3: 4 years experience in an analytics or related field.

Preferred Qualifications...

Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications.

Primary Location... Block- 1, Prestige Tech Pacific Park, Sy No. 38/1, Outer Ring Rd Kadubeesanahalli , India
