Continuously experiment with new sourcing methods, AI tools, and automation. Care about quality of hire, not just number of profiles submitted.
  • Can build trust with senior engineering and business stakeholders. What Success Looks Like Within the role, success would mean: Consistently delivering high-quality technical candidates within agreed timelines.
  • Building strong passive talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs. Successfully closing difficult and niche technical positions. Becoming a trusted talent partner for Engineering and Product leadership. Improving sourcing efficiency through AI, automation, research, and data. Maintaining healthy recruitment funnel conversion from sourcing screening interviews offer joining. Demonstrating strong ownership of hiring outcomes rather than measuring success only by activity volume. Continuously improving sourcing strategies based on market feedback and hiring data. Preferred Experience Experience hiring for Product Engineering, AI/ML, Data Engineering, Cloud, DevOps, Cybersecurity, or Enterprise SaaS organizations. Exposure to startup, high-growth, or product-led environments.
  • Experience with senior/leadership hiring or executive search. Exposure to global or cross-border hiring. Experience using modern ATS, sourcing platforms, talent intelligence tools, AI recruiting tools, and recruitment analytics. Experience building talent pools before positions formally open.

jobDescription:

At goML, were building the next generation of Machine Learning platforms and Generative AI services that solve real-world enterprise problems. In this role, youll design, build, and productionize GenAI systemsfrom model training and fine-tuning to deployment and monitoring. If youre excited about shaping how AI is built, scaled, and delivered, this is the place for you.


Why You? Why Now?

Generative AI is moving fast—from experimentation to enterprise adoption. We need engineers who can bridge research and production, build reliable ML pipelines, and turn GenAI breakthroughs into real business outcomes. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys ownership, experimentation, and solving complex problems end to end.


What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

First 30 Days: Foundation & Immersion


  • Understand goML’s ML and GenAI platforms, use cases, and architecture
  • Get familiar with existing training, inference, and deployment pipelines
  • Study current approaches to RAG, LLM fine-tuning, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and product teams to understand business problems

First 60 Days: Build & Experiment


  • Design and develop Generative AI solutions using techniques like RAG, transformers, and LLM-based architectures
  • Fine-tune pre-trained LLMs for domain-specific and task-specific use cases
  • Build and maintain data pipelines for training and inference workflows
  • Apply strong software engineering practices to ML and GenAI pipelines
  • Evaluate, analyze, and benchmark model performance and quality
  • Develop and deploy proof-of-concept GenAI systems

First 180 Days: Ownership & Scale


  • Own end-to-end ML/GenAI pipelines—from training to production deployment
  • Implement model optimization and compression techniques where applicable
  • Productionize ML and GenAI research for real-world enterprise use cases
  • Monitor deployed models and continuously improve performance and reliability
  • Stay current with advancements in Generative AI and apply them thoughtfully
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to solve challenging business problems at scale

What You Bring (Qualifications & Skills)

Must-Have


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field
  • 3–7 years of experience in Generative AI, Machine Learning, or related domains
  • Strong programming skills in Python
  • Hands-on experience with RAG and LLM-based architectures
  • Experience building data pipelines, deploying ML/GenAI models, and maintaining them in production
  • Solid understanding of ML/GenAI evaluation techniques
  • Proficiency with Git, Docker, and Linux-based systems
  • Experience working with cloud platforms, especially AWS ML/GenAI services

Nice-to-Have


  • Exposure to model compression and optimization techniques
  • Experience with popular ML/GenAI frameworks and tools
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices and monitoring systems
  • Experience working in fast-paced startup environments

title: SAP FI Senior Consultant
jobDescription:
Job Summary
Siamo alla ricerca di un/una SAP FI Senior Consultant!
Il tuo contributo in questo ruolo:
Come SAP FI Senior Consultant sarai il punto di riferimento funzionale per il modulo SAP FI, supportando il Project Manager nella pianificazione delle attivite coordinando il team durante le diverse fasi progettuali.
Nello specifico ti occuperai di:
  • Analizzare i processi di business e raccogliere i requisiti funzionali interfacciandoti con i Key User e gli stakeholder di progetto;
  • Progettare la soluzione applicativa, definendo l''architettura funzionale e configurando il modulo SAP FI attraverso attivitdi customizing;
  • Coordinare le attivitdel team funzionale e collaborare con i team tecnici durante le fasi di sviluppo, integrazione e rilascio delle soluzioni;
  • Predisporre e supervisionare la documentazione funzionale e tecnico-applicativa;
  • Definire la strategia di test, coordinare ed eseguire i test funzionali e supportare gli utenti durante le fasi di User Acceptance Test (UAT);
  • Pianificare e gestire le attivitdi Cut-over, Go-Live, Hypercare e supporto post-avviamento;
  • Partecipare a progetti di implementazione, roll-out internazionali, conversioni e migrazioni verso SAP S/4HANA, contribuendo alla trasformazione dei processi Finance;
  • Supportare il Project Manager nella pianificazione delle attivite nella gestione delle risorse coinvolte.
Il Profilo ideale
Il Profilo ideale:
  • Esperienza di almeno 5 anni sul modulo SAP FI;
  • Ottima conoscenza dei processi e delle funzionalita relative ai moduli:
    • SAP FI-GL (General Ledger);
    • SAP FI-AP (Accounts Payable);
    • SAP FI-AR (Accounts Receivable);
    • SAP FI-AA (Asset Accounting);
  • Solida conoscenza dell''integrazione del modulo SAP Finance con SAP Controlling (CO) e con i principali moduli logistici;
  • Esperienza nella gestione di risorse e nel coordinamento di team progettuali;
  • Ottime capacitrelazionali e di team working;
  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata;
  • Capacitdi leggere e interpretare il codice ABAP a supporto delle analisi funzionali;
  • Esperienza in progetti di Data Migration;
  • Esperienza in attivita SAP S/4HANA e in progettualita implementazione, conversione e trasformazione verso SAP S/4HANA;
  • Esperienza in progetti di Roll-out;
  • Esperienza in contesti internazionali e su progetti multi-country;
  • Familiaritcon soluzioni non standard, estensioni e customizzazioni evolutive in ambito SAP Finance.
Nice to have
  • Conoscenza della lingua spagnola;
  • Esperienza sul modulo SAP FI-TR (Treasury);
  • Conoscenza delle soluzioni SAP dedicate alla fiscalite alla compliance normativa, quali Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC), eDocument e strumenti analoghi

title: Senior RF Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Summary
Per la Integrated Communication Services Division di NTT DATA Italia stiamo ricercando figure di Senior RF Engineer con esperienze maturate nellambito della progettazione radioelettrica e ottimizzazioni di reti radiomobili per comunicazioni pubbliche, private e di sicurezza.
All''interno del team di lavoro, la persona si occuperdella progettazione RF, della validazione delle funzionalitdella rete attraverso campagne di test e della massimizzazione delle performance, garantendo la conformitai requisiti del cliente.
Responsibilities
Il tuo contributo in questo ruolo:
  • Analizzare le esigenze del cliente e gli scenari progettuali, traducendoli in requisiti di progetto chiari e strutturati;
  • Eseguire site survey per valutare le caratteristiche degli edifici o dei siti e identificare i vincoli installativi;
  • Valutare la copertura di rete esistente mediante strumenti di misura dellinterfaccia radio (es. Nemo, TEMS Investigation, RS ROMES4);
  • Dimensionare i servizi, il traffico e la capacitdi rete necessari per soddisfare i requisiti e selezionare larchitettura di Radio Access Network pi appropriata;
  • Eseguire calcoli di link budget per determinare il MAPL e il cell radius;
  • Effettuare simulazioni di copertura, interferenza e throughput, nonchottimizzare il posizionamento delle antenne, utilizzando strumenti di radio network planning (es.Atoll, Planet, Asset, iBwave);
  • Monitorare le prestazioni della rete radio attraverso lanalisi dei KPI e lesecuzione di test end-to-end;
  • Ottimizzare le prestazioni della rete radio attraverso interventi sulla configurazione del sito e sulla parametrizzazione delle celle;
  • Supportare il team Presales nelle attivitdi tendering e i Project Manager durante tutte le fasi di deployment della rete.
Qualifications
  • Almeno 10 anni di esperienza su progetti di Radio Network Planning Optimization;
  • Conoscenza approfondita delle tecnologie 4G/5G e delle architetture di rete radiomobile di ultima generazione per le reti pubbliche e private;
  • Buona conoscenza delle architetture DAS multi-operatore e multi-tecnologia per radio coperture indoor e outdoor;
  • Conoscenza approfondita dei tool di Radio Network Planning per le simulazioni della copertura radio outdoor (Atoll, Planet, Asset) e indoor (iBwave);
  • Buona conoscenza dei tool di test per la misura e analisi dei parametri di rete di accesso radio (Nemo, TEMS);
  • Conoscenza dei tool di misura a radiofrequenza per il rilevamento dellinterferenza;
  • Competenza nella definizione di una lista di test e nellesecuzione dei test di validazione delle prestazioni di rete radiomobile;
  • Buone competenze di troubleshooting dei KPI di rete e capacitdi fornire indicazioni sulle modifiche parametriche per lottimizzazione delle prestazioni;
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua italiana o madrelingua;
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua Inglese;
  • Disponibilitad operare in trasferta, anche internazionale;
  • Ottime doti relazionali e predisposizione al lavoro di gruppo in contesti dinamici e in continua evoluzione;
  • Ottime capacitcomunicative e di negoziazione;
  • Ottime capacitdi sintesi e trasmissione efficace delle informazioni, sia in forma scritta che orale;
  • Capacitdi adattamento a diversi ambiti di lavoro;
  • Approccio orientato al raggiungimento degli obiettivi ed eccellenti capacitdi problem solving.
Nice to have
  • Conoscenza delle reti GSM-R e TETRA per le comunicazioni radiomobili mission critical
  • Esperienza su commissioning di stazioni radio base e DAS
  • Esperienza nel coordinamento tecnico di un team
Sede di lavoro
Italia, con possibilitdi modalitdi lavoro Ibrida (Smart Working).

title: UiPath RPA Administrator
jobDescription:
Job Summary
We are currently seeking a UiPath RPA Administrator to join our team in Bangalore, Karntaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
Responsibilities
  • A UiPath RPA Administrator sits somewhere between a Power Platform admin, application administrator, and automation platform engineer. The role is usually responsible for the UiPath platform itself rather than developing automations.
  • Core Technical Skills
    • This is the most important skill area.
    • You should understand:
    • Tenants and folders
    • Users, groups, and roles
    • Robot provisioning
    • Machine templates
    • Assets
    • Queues
    • Triggers/schedules
    • Packages and libraries
    • Monitoring and logs
    • High availability and upgrades
  • Identity Security
    • Most organizations integrate UiPath with Entra ID (Azure AD).
    • Skills include:
    • SSO and SAML
    • Active Directory / Entra ID integration
    • RBAC (Role-Based Access Control)
    • Service accounts
    • Credential management
    • CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, or Azure Key Vault integrations
    • Audit and compliance requirements
  • Infrastructure Skills
    • Depending on deployment model:
    • UiPath Automation Cloud
      • Tenant management
      • Licensing
      • Network connectivity
      • Governance policies
    • UiPath On-Prem
      • Windows Server
      • IIS
      • SQL Server
      • Certificates
      • Load balancers
      • Backup/recovery
      • Disaster recovery
  • Database Knowledge
    • Not necessarily DBA-level, but you should understand:
    • SQL Server basics
    • Reading logs and queries
    • Performance troubleshooting
    • Database maintenance concepts
  • Automation Knowledge
    • Even if you''re not a developer, it helps to understand:
    • UiPath Studio
    • REFramework
    • Attended vs Unattended bots
    • Transaction processing
    • Exception handling
    • Version control concepts
  • Monitoring Support
    • A lot of the admin role is troubleshooting.
    • Common tasks:
    • Failed jobs
    • Expired credentials
    • Queue failures
    • Licensing issues
    • Package deployment issues
    • Robot connectivity
    • Certificate problems
    • Permission issues
  • PowerShell Scripting
    • Very valuable for:
    • User provisioning
    • License reporting
    • Bulk updates
    • Health checks
    • API integrations
  • Languages often used
    • PowerShell
    • REST APIs
    • JSON
  • Governance Compliance
    • An experienced UiPath admin should understand:
    • Change management
    • Production deployments
    • Segregation of duties
    • Audit requirements
    • Bot lifecycle management
    • Disaster recovery planning

  • Support final cutover, post-load validation, payroll parallel, and hypercare issue resolution.

  • Hands-on experience migrating Oracle Fusion HCM and Payroll data using HDL, HSDL, HCM Extracts, BI Publisher, REST APIs, or related loaders.

  • Experience with payroll conversion, balance loading, payroll reconciliation, and payroll parallel testing support.
  • Strong SQL/data transformation skills and ability to work with complex date-effective and hierarchical data.
  • Understanding of data privacy, security, sensitive personal data, and controlled handling of payroll/HR data.
  • Ability to troubleshoot HDL errors, dependency issues, object sequencing, and validation failures.
  • Experience coordinating with OTL, Projects, Finance, integrations, and reporting teams for downstream workforce dependencies.
  • Strong documentation skills for mapping, transformation rules, load files, reconciliation reports, and cutover steps.
Key deliverables
  • HCM/Core HR/Payroll data inventory and source-to-target mapping workbook.
  • HCM extract specifications, transformation logic, and load sequencing plan.
  • HDL/HSDL/load-ready files for in-scope workers, assignments, payroll objects, balances, and related data.
  • HCM and payroll data quality reports and cleansing issue log.
  • Mock conversion logs, HDL error analysis, and remediation tracker.
  • Worker, assignment, payroll relationship, element, balance, and payment reconciliation pack.
  • Cutover load runbook and hypercare data support guide.
Success measures
  • In-scope workforce population is migrated accurately with correct work structures, assignments, payroll relationships, and security dependencies.
  • Payroll balances and parallel results reconcile to agreed thresholds.
  • HDL/HSDL loads are repeatable, controlled, and executable within cutover timelines.
  • HR and payroll business owners approve migration results before go-live.

Works closely with HCM/Payroll Functional Specialists, OTL teams, Projects, Finance, Security, Integration Developers, Reporting/EPM, and HR/payroll operations.

We are looking for a hands-on Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) / DevOps Engineer with strong programming and automation skills.
The role will initially involve development and automation work, helping the engineer build a strong understanding of the applications and platform. Over time, the role will expand into broader DevOps and SRE responsibilities, including CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, observability, production reliability, incident management, and operational automation.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with both application code and production systems and should use engineering and automation to improve reliability and reduce manual effort.

  • Participate in code reviews, debugging, testing, and technical discussions.
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
  • Work with Docker and Kubernetes for application deployment and operations.
  • Support on prem and cloud-based application and infrastructure deployments.
  • Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and highly available production environments.
  • Implement and manage monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions.
  • Contribute to defining and tracking SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets.
  • Troubleshoot application and production issues and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, Git, pull requests, and code reviews.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix environments and basic Windows administration.
  • Good understanding of networking concepts including DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, load balancing, and firewalls.

  • Engineering and automation mindset.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Ownership-driven approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to remain structured during production incidents.

Role: Hands-on Technical Lead - AI / Deep Learning / Generative AI

Role Profile

  • We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Deep Learning Lead with 4-6 years of experience to lead the design, development, optimization, and deployment of advanced Deep Learning, Generative AI, LLM, RAG, Agentic AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Multimodal AI solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of production-grade Deep Learning and AI solutions.
  • Design and implement advanced neural network architectures using PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, and related frameworks.
  • Develop and optimize AI/ML models for real-world enterprise applications.
  • Work extensively with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Transformer architectures, embeddings, and foundation models.
  • Build LLM-powered applications using both proprietary and open-source models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, and equivalent models.
  • Design and implement production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
  • Develop advanced RAG solutions involving semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, query expansion, contextual retrieval, Agentic RAG, and GraphRAG.
  • Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, FAISS, ChromaDB, pgvector, or equivalent.
  • Design efficient document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embedding, indexing, retrieval, and context-generation pipelines.
  • Develop and optimize AI Agents and Agentic AI workflows involving reasoning, planning, memory, tool calling, and autonomous task execution.
  • Build multi-agent systems and orchestration workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
  • Work with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other emerging agent interoperability technologies.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Workforce Reinvention - AI Engineer will help scale modular tools, intelligent workflows, and production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that support internal business operations. This person will serve as a pragmatic builder who consistently selects the most efficient solution for each challenge, whether through system integrations, lightweight scripting, reusable automation components, or custom AI agents.

The role will focus initially on maturing existing AI proofs-of-concept into reliable production systems while establishing engineering rigor through Test-Driven Development (TDD), CI/CD automation, infrastructure-as-code practices, and operational monitoring.

Success in this role will require strong partnership with internal AI Champions across departments to create reusable automation capabilities that empower teams to safely self-serve and scale intelligent workflows across OpenSesame.

Performance Objectives

30 Days - Onboarding, Context, and First Contribution

  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the current Workforce Reinvention architecture, codebase, deployment pipeline, and existing AI proofs-of-concept while building strong working relationships with AI Champions in Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
  • Within the first month, successfully contribute and deploy a small but meaningful workflow improvement, automation script, or enhancement to an active internal tool while demonstrating the ability to operate within the team s TDD and CI/CD practices and release processes.

60 Days - Production Launch & Component Foundations

  • Take ownership of deploying a production-grade RAG workflow or intelligent internal tool built from a previously validated concept, ensuring the solution is stable, maintainable, and valuable to internal stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with AI Champions to identify and prioritize workflow bottlenecks while beginning to establish reusable modular automation blocks and standardized development patterns that form the foundation of a scalable enterprise component library.

90 Days - Engineering Rigor & Pipeline Optimization

  • Lead improvements to the CI/CD pipeline that significantly reduce manual deployment steps, improve release reliability, and accelerate software delivery across automation initiatives.
  • Begin implementing infrastructure-as-code practices using tools such as Terraform while introducing robust monitoring, logging, and observability standards that improve system reliability, track operational costs, and support a target uptime of 99.9% for critical internal automation APIs and workflows.

6 Months - The Scalable Automation Ecosystem

  • Fully establish and maintain a reusable component library that enables rapid deployment of AI-driven and traditional automation workflows across multiple business units while empowering AI Champions to safely self-serve and scale departmental solutions independently.
  • Create a sustainable operational model where engineering maintains stable infrastructure, automated testing eliminates operational toil, documentation supports non-technical users, and intelligent workflows become a dependable force multiplier across the organization.

What Success Looks Like

  • Successfully turns experimental AI ideas into scalable production systems that improve operational efficiency across OpenSesame.
  • Builds reliable, maintainable automation frameworks that internal teams can confidently use and expand on.
  • Becomes a trusted technical partner to AI Champions and helps create a scalable automation ecosystem that increases productivity across the company.

You might notice we don t list a traditional set of requirements or buzzwords here. That s intentional.

We re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can build brands, create scalable systems, and drive measurable marketing impact. When you look back a year from now, you ll know you ve elevated OpenSesame s brand and strengthened its market presence.

Location

This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company and invest in all-company in-person meetings several times a year.

Performance Driven

Were looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but were highly selective about who we hire. We dont focus on typical job requirements; instead, were interested in specific examples from your past experiences. All positions can be based anywhere in the US, and require up to 15 days of travel per year, with senior management and leadership teams requiring up to 35 days.

title: Sr Legal Counsel
jobDescription:
Job Description
We are looking for an independent, commercially-minded lawyer, based in India, to own BlueOptima s legal function on a full-time basis. The role principally supports the contracting that underpins our enterprise SaaS business and owns, maintains and improves the legal framework that supports a fast-moving, multi-jurisdiction group.
Commercial deals are sold through our UK and US entities, and BlueOptima contracts on its own standard paper governed by England & Wales, New York or Swiss law. You will negotiate directly with counterparties - including some of the world s largest enterprises - so the ability to lead difficult, high-value negotiations to a clean close with limited supervision is central to the role.
In addition to the group commercial work, you will be the legal point of contact for the India entity, covering Indian employment law and local statutory compliance. The role reports to the UK-based Head of Finance and requires working hours with meaningful overlap with the UK and US business day.
Duties and Responsibilities
  • Enterprise contract negotiation. Lead negotiations directly with large enterprise counterparties - from engagement through redlining to close - explaining standard terms and holding the company s fall-back positions on complex, high-value deals.
  • Commercial contracting. Draft, review and negotiate MSAs, order forms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs across England & Wales, New York and Swiss-governed paper, supporting deals sold through the UK and US entities.
  • India entity legal & compliance. Act as legal point of contact for the India entity - employment-law matters, local statutory and regulatory compliance, and entity-level legal support.
  • Legal framework and playbooks. Own, maintain and optimise standard templates, fall-back positions, contract policies and the contract-management system; drive continuous improvement.
  • Vendor and procurement contracts. Review and negotiate inbound supplier, SaaS, professional-services and confidentiality agreements.
  • Data privacy and InfoSec. Handle data-protection matters (including GDPR-governed obligations), negotiate DPAs, and support InfoSec policy management and customer security requirements.
  • IP protection. Support IP protection, assignment and related strategy.
  • AI enablement. Embed AI tooling across legal review, triage, drafting and contract analysis, and help shape the company s approach to AI-related legal and regulatory questions. Qualifications
Required
  • Qualified lawyer with excellent academic credentials, qualified to advise on England & Wales, New York Law. England & Wales qualification is the target profile; equivalent demonstrable experience drafting and negotiating under E&W law will also be considered.
  • 4+ years PQE in a corporate/commercial team at a leading firm and/or comparable in-house environment.
  • Proven experience leading negotiations directly with Western / international enterprise counterparties through to close - not solely reviewing or marking up documents.
  • Multi-governing-law commercial drafting - comfortable working across more than one of England & Wales, New York and Swiss law.
  • Working knowledge of Indian employment law and local statutory compliance (India bar enrolment is not required).
  • Working knowledge of our other locations, Mexico, UK, Japan, US.
  • Strong commercial drafting across MSAs, DPAs and NDAs, plus sound data-privacy knowledge - for SAAS industry.
  • Genuinely independent and self-sufficient - able to own the function with minimal day-to-day UK oversight.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; clear communicator with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Willing and able to work hours with meaningful overlap with the UK and US business day.
Desirable
  • Experience with AI - a significant plus - whether using AI tools within legal workflows, or advising on AI legal/regulatory frameworks.
  • US (New York State) qualification and/or experience under Swiss-governed contracts.
  • Prior in-house experience in a SaaS / enterprise software business serving Western enterprise clients.
  • Breadth across IP and InfoSec policy management.

Griffin is a private, invitation-only club that unites India s top tech founders through curated experiences, strategic learning, and peer-driven growth. Designed for India s unicorn and soonicorn founders - building at scale, Griffin offers a trusted space where founders don t just network-they forge deep, meaningful relationships, share unfiltered insights, and collaborate to shape India s next chapter of innovation.

From intimate salons and high-trust retreats to access to capital and exclusive opportunities, Griffin offers a curated path to clarity, collaboration, and personal growth. More than a community, it s the inner circle powering the next wave of industry-shaping leaders.

Job Overview
At Griffin, design is not decoration. It is how the institution expresses taste, trust, discretion and ambition.

As Graphic Designer, Griffin Club, you will be responsible for shaping the visual language of one of India s most exclusive founder circles. You will work closely with the Griffin leadership team to create design assets for member communication, private events, founder experiences, strategic decks, invitations, gifting, digital properties and institutional storytelling.

This is a role for someone who understands that Griffin should never look loud, mass-market or promotional. Every visual touchpoint must feel premium, considered and founder-worthy.

You will not just make creatives. You will help build the visual identity of a private institution for India s most consequential founders.

Your Impact In This Role
Shape Griffin s Visual Identity: Build and maintain a premium, consistent and recognisable design language for Griffin across all touchpoints.

Design For India s Top Founders: Create assets that are seen by unicorn founders, policymakers, investors, institutional leaders and global business figures.
Elevate Every Griffin Experience: Ensure every invite, deck, menu card, agenda, signage, gifting insert, event creative and post-event asset feels intentional and high-quality.

Bring Order To Brand Assets: Create templates, systems and design guidelines so Griffin s visual output becomes faster, cleaner and more consistent over time.
Experiment With AI-Led Design Tools: Use AI tools where relevant to improve speed, ideation, moodboarding, image treatment and visual exploration.

Primary Responsibilities
1. Build And Maintain Griffin s Design System
  • Create and maintain Griffin s visual design system across digital and physical assets.
  • Develop reusable templates for invites, decks, event agendas, speaker cards, WhatsApp creatives, member profiles, newsletters and internal documents.
  • Ensure consistency in typography, colours, spacing, image treatment, visual hierarchy and premium brand language.
  • Build a clean archive of design files, brand assets, templates, logos, fonts, image banks and final exports.
  • Protect Griffin s design quality so that no asset feels rushed, cluttered or generic.
2. Design For Griffin Events And Experiences
  • Create design assets for Griffin Salons, Retreats, Priv gatherings, delegations, dinners, IPO Dialogue, founder roundtables and special access moments.
  • Design event invites, save-the-dates, agenda cards, speaker cards, room branding, table cards, menu cards, backdrops, signage and post-event creatives.
  • Work with the team to understand the mood, audience and purpose of each Griffin format before designing.
  • Ensure every event asset feels aligned with the room - private, premium, discreet and high-trust.
  • Coordinate with vendors, printers and production partners to ensure correct formats, sizes and final outputs.
3. Create Founder And Member-Facing Assets
  • Design member welcome assets, onboarding materials, profile cards and special milestone creatives.
  • Create high-quality visuals for founder introductions, member achievements, IPO moments, fundraises, launches and other key member milestones.
  • Support the team in creating visually polished communication for WhatsApp groups, emailers and member-facing updates.
  • Ensure all member-facing assets feel personal, elegant and respectful.
4. Support Strategic Decks And Institutional Documents
  • Design and polish Griffin decks, partnership decks, membership notes, government notes, event proposals, sponsor decks and internal strategy documents.
  • Convert rough content into clean, structured and visually sharp presentations.
  • Work closely with the leadership team to translate complex ideas into simple and premium visual storytelling.
  • Maintain a repository of approved slides, design modules and visual templates for repeat use.
5. Support Brand, Content And Digital Assets
  • Create digital creatives for Griffin s website, social communication, post-event storytelling and founder-safe public narratives.
  • Design visual assets for event recaps, photo stories, quote cards, announcements and institutional storytelling.
  • Work with photographers, videographers and content teams to select, crop, retouch and package visuals.
  • Ensure Griffin s public-facing design remains aspirational but restrained.
6. Own Design Execution Discipline
  • Maintain timelines for all design requests.
  • Understand briefs clearly before starting work.
  • Ask the right questions on audience, format, tone, size, usage and deadline.
  • Share design options with clarity and rationale.
  • Keep all final files properly named, organised and accessible.
  • Ensure print-ready and digital-ready formats are delivered correctly.
  • Coordinate with the team for feedback, approvals and final sign-off.

What Sets You Apart
  • Premium Design Sensibility: You understand restraint, whitespace, typography, hierarchy and taste.
  • Detail Orientation: You notice alignment, spacing, image quality, file formats and finishing.
  • Founder-First Thinking: You understand that the audience is not generic. These are high-context, high-expectation founders.
  • Speed With Quality: You can move fast without making things look careless.
  • Structured Execution: You can create repeatable templates and systems, not just one-off designs.
  • Visual Storytelling: You can convert an idea, event or founder profile into a sharp visual narrative.
  • Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility for the final output, not just the design file.
  • High Taste, Low Noise: You know how to make something feel premium without making it loud.
  • Curiosity For AI Tools: You are open to using AI tools to moodboard, ideate, enhance images, create variations and improve design efficiency.

Professional Traits
  • 2-3 years of experience in graphic design, visual communication, brand design, event design, editorial design or premium brand design.
  • Strong command over Adobe Creative Suite, especially Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
  • Strong working knowledge of Figma, Canva or similar collaborative design tools.
  • Ability to design both digital and print assets.
  • Good understanding of typography, layout, composition, colour and visual hierarchy.
  • Experience designing decks, invites, event collaterals, social creatives and brand assets.
  • Ability to work with tight timelines and multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong file hygiene and ability to maintain organised design repositories.
  • Ability to take feedback maturely and improve output quickly.
  • Good written communication and ability to understand premium brand tone.
  • Bonus: Experience working with luxury brands, premium events, founder communities, media companies, design studios or hospitality brands.
  • Bonus: Working knowledge of AI design tools such as Midjourney, ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly, Runway, DALL E, Canva AI or similar tools.

Key Design Outputs You Will Own
  • Event Design -Invites, agendas, speaker cards, signage, menu cards, backdrops
  • Member Communication- WhatsApp creatives, founder intro cards, milestone creatives
  • Strategic Decks- Membership decks, partner decks, government notes, event proposals
  • Brand Assets- Templates, visual systems, typography rules, iconography, layouts
  • Digital Assets- Website visuals, post-event assets, social creatives
  • Print Assets- Brochures, table cards, inserts, gifting notes, experience collaterals
  • Internal Assets- SOPs, trackers, operating documents, briefing notes, team decks

What Good Looks Like

Success in this role means:
  • Griffin has a consistent and premium visual language.
  • Every major Griffin event has high-quality design assets ready on time.
  • Founder-facing communication looks polished, intentional and discreet.
  • Decks and documents feel sharp, structured and senior.
  • Templates reduce repeated design effort.
  • Design files are organised and easy for the team to access.
  • The team trusts you to convert rough ideas into refined visual outputs.
  • Griffin s design starts feeling like that of a serious private institution, not an event brand.
Who This Role Is For
  • This role is ideal for someone who wants to build design for a premium, high-trust founder institution from the ground up.
  • You should enjoy working on:
  • Private member experiences
  • High-quality event identities
  • Founder-facing communication
  • Premium decks and documents
  • Minimal, elegant design systems
  • Tasteful brand storytelling
  • Fast-moving but high-standard execution
  • You should be comfortable with ambiguity, feedback and iteration.
  • At Griffin, design will often begin with a rough idea, a WhatsApp note or a strategic conversation. Your job is to bring structure, taste and clarity to it.
Who This Role Is Not For
This role may not be the right fit if:
  • You prefer only social media design.
  • You are uncomfortable with fast timelines.
  • You need extremely detailed briefs for every asset.
  • You struggle with senior stakeholder feedback.
  • You prefer loud, flashy or template-heavy design.
  • You do not enjoy organising files, templates and systems.
  • You treat design as execution only, not as brand-building.
Reporting
The role will work closely with the Founder s Office and Griffin leadership team.
The designer will collaborate with content, events, partnerships, member experience and external vendors, depending on the asset.

Role Summary
The Graphic Designer at Griffin will help define how Griffin is seen, felt and remembered.

This is a design role for someone who wants to create work that is subtle, premium, deeply considered and visible to some of India s most influential founders and institutional leaders.

Full-Stack Software Engineer (Java / Spring Boot + React)

Location: [Remote / Hybrid - Noida] Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 3-6 years

Compensation: [ 5 LPA]

About the Role

We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer who can take ownership of a feature or business module end to

end-from understanding the business problem and designing the solution to implementation, testing, deployment,

and production support.

You will work closely with the engineer responsible for the system architecture as well as business and product

stakeholders who own the requirements. This gives you the context, ownership, and autonomy to make sound

technical decisions.

This is a high-ownership engineering role. You will not simply receive predefined development tickets. You will

be expected to understand the underlying business problem, ask the right questions, identify gaps and edge cases,

and translate requirements into reliable production-ready software.

Key Responsibilities

- Translate business requirements into technical designs covering data models, API contracts, workflow

states, authorization rules, and system behavior .

- Proactively identify gaps, contradictions, edge cases, and potential failure scenarios before

implementation begins.

- Contribute to architectural decisions involving database/schema design, service boundaries, caching,

asynchronous processing, background jobs, and integration patterns .

- Build features end to end, including PostgreSQL schemas and migrations, Spring Boot services, REST

APIs, and React-based user interfaces .

- Implement audit trails, immutable transaction histories, and reporting capabilities for workflows

where data integrity and correctness are critical.

- Design and integrate third-party services such as payment gateways, logistics/courier APIs, email, SMS,

and messaging platforms .

- Review peer pull requests with a focus on correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and

engineering standards .

- Write comprehensive unit and integration tests, covering business rules, edge cases, failure scenarios, and

negative cases-not just the happy path.

- Follow disciplined engineering practices around coding standards, Git workflows, branching, pull

requests, and clean commit history .

- Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and support the systems you build in production.

- Participate in incident response, debugging, root-cause analysis, and preventive improvements.

- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, deployment automation, and release-

process improvements . - Maintain technical documentation covering APIs, database/schema decisions, configuration,

operational procedures, and runbooks .

- Work directly with non-technical stakeholders to clarify requirements and communicate technical

constraints, risks, and trade-offs in a clear and actionable manner.

Required Skills & Experience

- 3+ years of experience building and shipping production-grade web applications as a full-stack engineer.

- Strong hands-on experience with Java 17/21, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.

- Strong understanding of REST API design, including:

- API versioning

- Pagination

- Request validation

- Error handling and error contracts

- API documentation

- Good experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, including:

- Component-based development

- State management

- Forms

- Protected routes

- API integration

- Responsive interfaces

- Experience with JUnit, Mockito, and integration testing.

- Strong understanding of Git and collaborative development practices, including branching, pull requests,

and code reviews.

- Hands-on experience with Docker.

- Comfortable deploying, monitoring, debugging, and troubleshooting applications on AWS or GCP.

Good to Have

Experience in one or more of the following will be an advantage:

- Building multi-tenant SaaS applications, including tenant isolation and data-access controls.

- Event-driven architecture , Kafka, message queues, and asynchronous processing.

- Integrating payment gateways, logistics platforms, courier services, or other third-party APIs.

- Building reporting, analytics, or data-intensive dashboards. - Integrating LLM/AI-powered capabilities into production applications.

- Experience working on systems involving complex workflows, approvals, permissions, or transactional

data .

What We Look For

We value engineers who:

- Take ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

- Think about the business problem, not just the technical implementation.

- Ask questions when requirements are unclear.

- Identify edge cases before they become production issues.

- Care about data correctness and system reliability.

- Can make pragmatic technical decisions and explain their trade-offs.

- Write maintainable code that other engineers can understand and extend.

- Are comfortable working across the frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure.

- Treat testing, documentation, monitoring, and production support as part of engineering-not as

afterthoughts.

Job Description

As Product Security Engineer - Senior, you will:

  • Implement and continuously improve Sprinklrs cloud security controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
  • Perform security assessments of cloud infrastructure, IAM configurations, network architectures, Kubernetes environments, and cloud services to identify risks and recommend practical remediation.

  • Design, write, and execute detailed test cases and test plans for functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing of web applications.

  • Conduct end-to-end manual validation of user stories and acceptance criteria, working closely with product and design stakeholders.

  • Participate in sprint ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure quality is built into every stage of the process.

Automation Testing

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for web applications using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or equivalent.
  • Write clean, reusable, and maintainable automated test scripts in TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) to enable continuous testing on every build.
  • Monitor and analyse automated test results, investigate flaky tests, and maintain a high level of automation coverage across critical user journeys.
  • Contribute to test strategy discussions and advocate for automation-first approaches where appropriate.

API Testing

  • Design and execute comprehensive API test suites for RESTful services using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent.
  • Validate request/response payloads, status codes, authentication flows, and error handling across API contracts.
  • Collaborate with backend developers to review API specifications and flag potential issues before implementation.
  • Automate API test collections and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline for continuous API quality validation.

Regression Testing

  • Own and maintain the regression test suite, ensuring comprehensive coverage of core platform functionality.
  • Execute full and targeted regression cycles ahead of each release, clearly documenting scope, results, and sign-off status.
  • Identify areas of the application most susceptible to regression risk and prioritise automation coverage accordingly.
  • Track and report regression metrics over time to support continuous quality improvement.

Release Validation

  • Act as the quality gate for each release, coordinating release validation activities across environments (dev, staging, production).
  • Prepare and execute release checklists, smoke tests, and sanity checks to confirm production readiness.
  • Work with DevOps and engineering leads to validate deployments and sign off on go-live readiness.
  • Document release test outcomes and communicate clearly to stakeholders on quality status and any outstanding risks.

Quality Engineering & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with developers, product managers, and designers to define acceptance criteria and establish a shared definition of done.
  • Champion a quality-first culture within the team through proactive defect prevention, shift-left testing practices, and continuous feedback.
  • Maintain up-to-date test documentation, including test plans, test reports, and traceability matrices.
  • Mentor junior QA team members and contribute to QA best practices and internal knowledge sharing.

  • Manual Testing: Test case design, exploratory testing, UAT, regression, cross-browser testing

  • Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript
  • API Testing: Postman, RestAssured or equivalent; REST API validation, contract testing
  • CI/CD Integration: GitHub Actions or equivalent; integrating test suites into build pipelines
  • Defect Management: Jira or equivalent; defect lifecycle, severity classification, reporting
  • Test Management: TestRail, Zephyr, or equivalent; test plans, traceability matrices, test reporting
  • Regression Testing: Regression suite ownership, coverage strategy, scheduled regression cycles
  • Release Validation: Release checklists, smoke/sanity testing, environment validation, go-live sign-off

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Computer Operators at Kyndryl are key in helping revolutionize the way we operate complex computer systems. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, supervise and control intricate networks and applications, and operate distributed systems in a multi-vendor environment.

As a Computer Operator you will be on the technical frontline - performing batch operations as per service agreements, analyzing first-level issues across systems, and resolving/routing issues as appropriate. You will also have the opportunity to develop support system management processes specific to customer requirements, ensuring that we provide the highest level of service to our customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve JCL abends, override issues, and symbolic parameter problems.
  • Allocate and manage BIOS, TIF, GDG, and VSAM datasets.
  • Identify ownership of Production and QA jobs and coordinate with appropriate development groups.
  • Perform file out-of-space (FOOS) recovery and support batch/online recovery activities.
  • Coordinate batch job restarts, abend recovery, and customer escalations.
  • Utilize break-glass procedures for emergency production support access when required.
  • Monitor and manage OPC/TWS job scheduling activities including hold/release actions, predecessor/successor analysis, and database lookups.
  • Support NDM/Connect: Direct operations including process monitoring, troubleshooting transfer failures, DR transfers, and client file transfers.
  • Perform PDX activities including installs, promotes, backouts, and password reset support using Power IDs.
  • Manage ITSM incidents, problem tickets, FACHA/Hot Item creation, ticket reassignment, and closure activities.
  • Process TSSR work orders, manage production/QA job requests, and respond to operational emails within SLA timelines.
  • Execute weekend IPL support activities, validate environment availability, and coordinate fixes for out-of-sequence abends.
  • Ensure Production, QA, and Test regions are operational following maintenance and IPL activities.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • 4 to 5 years of experience in Mainframe Batch & Console Operations.
  • Strong experience in Mainframe Production Support, including:
    • JCL troubleshooting and abend resolution
    • OPC/TWS scheduling
    • NDM / Connect:Direct
    • VSAM, GDG, DB2, and TSO/ISPF dataset management
    • PDX deployment support
    • ITSM ticket management
    • Batch monitoring and recovery
    • Incident and problem management
    • IPL support activities
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Experience with job scheduling tools, reporting, and logging systems.
  • Proficiency in Windows and Mac operating systems.
  • Experience in troubleshooting, backup and recovery, and basic networking concepts.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  • Ability to work in a 24x7 production support environment.
  • Experience in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and service restoration activities.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

Senior Backend Engineer - Database Change Management

An overview of this role

About the Role :
We are looking for a highly creative and technically strong Motion Graphics Designer with 4 to 5 years of professional experience to join our creative team in Mumbai.

The ideal candidate will have a strong command of motion design, video editing, visual effects, compositing, and post-production, along with a genuine interest in leveraging AI tools for video and content generation.

You should be someone who can take an idea from concept to final output - developing visual concepts, creating animations, editing footage, incorporating VFX, experimenting with AI-generated assets, and delivering polished content across digital and social platforms.


Key Responsibilities
- Create high-quality motion graphics, animations, video content, and visual compositions for digital, social, marketing, advertising, and branded content.
- Conceptualize and execute creative ideas from storyboard/concept stage through final delivery.

- Handle end-to-end video editing and post-production, including cuts, transitions, pacing, sound design, colour correction, compositing, and finishing.
- Create 2D/3D motion graphics, kinetic typography, title animations, logo animations, explainers, product animations, and social-first content.
- Work on VFX and compositing, including green-screen/keying, tracking, rotoscoping, masking, cleanup, screen replacement, compositing, and visual enhancements.
- Use AI-powered creative tools to generate and enhance video, images, motion assets, backgrounds, concepts, storyboards, and other visual content.
- Experiment with emerging generative AI tools and workflows to improve creative output, speed, and production efficiency.
- Integrate AI-generated assets seamlessly into professional video and motion-graphics workflows.
- Collaborate with creative directors, designers, copywriters, marketing teams, and other stakeholders to translate briefs into compelling visual content.
- Adapt content into multiple formats, aspect ratios, durations, and platform specifications for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, websites, advertising platforms, presentations, etc.

- Maintain strong visual quality and consistency across all deliverables.
- Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.
- Stay updated with emerging motion design, VFX, video-production, and generative AI trends and tools.

Required Skills & Experience
- 4 to 5 years of professional experience in Motion Graphics, Video Design, Animation, VFX, or a closely related creative role.
- Strong portfolio demonstrating motion graphics, video editing, animation, VFX, and post-production work.
- Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro.
- Good working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
- Strong understanding of motion principles, timing, composition, typography, transitions, colour, and visual storytelling.

Experience with compositing, tracking, keying, masking, rotoscoping, and VFX workflows.
Knowledge of 3D tools such as Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar is an advantage.
Experience using AI/generative AI tools for video and visual content creation.
Ability to combine traditional creative tools with AI-assisted production workflows.
Strong understanding of video formats, codecs, resolutions, frame rates, and platform-specific
deliverables.
Good sense of design aesthetics, storytelling, pacing, and current visual trends.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced creative environment.


**AI Skills are Strongly Preferred


Hands-on experience with AI tools for:
Text-to-video / image-to-video generation
AI-assisted video editing and enhancement
Generative image creation and asset development
AI voiceover, dubbing, lip-sync, and audio generation
AI-based background/object generation and replacement
Image/video upscaling and restoration
AI-assisted rotoscoping, masking, tracking, and compositing
Rapid prototyping and concept development
Candidates who actively experiment with new generative AI video and creative tools and can demonstrate. practical applications in their portfolio will be preferred.

Basic sound design and audio editing skills
Experience creating content for brands, advertising, social media, or digital platforms

Ability to create storyboards and visual treatments
Experience working with AI-generated video while maintaining professional production quality

  • Leverage GenAI tools to accelerate test case generation, automation development, debugging, documentation, and productivity.
  • Contribute to AI testing frameworks, accelerators, and Quality Engineering best practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers and promote automation-first and AI-first Quality Engineering practices.

Must have skills:

  • Strong understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), SDLC, Agile, and Scrum methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience in designing test strategies, test scenarios, test cases, and test execution.
  • Strong expertise in UI automation using Playwright and API automation using REST Assured (Java) or Python Requests.

descriptionFromApi:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 25 years of hands-on experience in building and deploying machine learning solutions in the fintech and spend management domain. You will work on real-time forecasting, intelligent document processing (invoices/receipts), fraud detection, and other AI-powered features that enhance our finance intelligence platform. This role demands expertise in both time series forecasting and computer vision, as well as a solid understanding of how ML applies to enterprise finance operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, and deploy ML models for spend forecasting, budget prediction, expense categorization, and risk scoring.
  • Build and optimize OCR-based invoice and receipt parsing systems using computer vision and NLP techniques.
  • Implement time-series models (Prophet, ARIMA, LSTM, XGBoost, etc.) for forecasting trends in financial transactions, expenses, and vendor payments.
  • Work on intelligent document classification, key-value extraction, and line-item detection from unstructured financial documents (PDFs, scanned images).
  • Collaborate with product and finance teams to define high-impact AI use cases and deliver business-ready solutions.
  • Integrate ML pipelines into production using scalable tools and platforms (Docker, CI/CD, cloud services).
  • Monitor model performance post-deployment, conduct drift analysis, and implement retraining strategies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Core Machine Learning

  • Strong knowledge of supervised and unsupervised ML techniques applied to structured and semi-structured financial data.
  • Experience in time-series analysis and forecasting algorithms such as:
    • ARIMA, SARIMA
    • Facebook Prophet
    • XGBoost for regression
    • LSTM / GRU models for sequential data
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, StatsModels, PyTorch, TensorFlow.

Computer Vision & Document AI

  • Hands-on experience with OCR tools such as Tesseract, Google Vision API, or AWS Textract.
  • Knowledge of document layout analysis and field-level extraction using OpenCV, LayoutLM, or Google Document AI.
  • Familiarity with annotation tools (Label Studio, CVAT) and post-processing OCR outputs for structured data extraction.

Deployment & Engineering

  • Experience in exposing ML models via Flask or FastAPI.
  • Model packaging and deployment with Docker, version control with Git, and ML lifecycle tools like MLflow or DVC.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and integrating models with backend microservices.

Data & Domain

  • Understanding of financial documents: invoices, receipts, expense reports, and GL data.
  • Ability to work with tabular, image-based, and PDF-based financial datasets.
  • SQL proficiency and familiarity with financial databases or ERP systems is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with fraud detection, anomaly detection, or compliance risk models in the fintech space.
  • Familiarity with vector databases (like Milvus, Pinecone) and embedding models (e.g., OpenAI, BERT, Sentence-BERT) for semantic search in finance.

jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities

A. Student Training & Facilitation

  • Conduct engaging, hands-on AI sessions for students of Grades 6-12 and adapt facilitation to different age groups and prior skill levels.
  • Explain complex AI, coding, product and digital-creation concepts using simple, age-appropriate examples, demonstrations and project-based activities.
  • Guide students through ideation, prototyping, building, testing, debugging, peer feedback, iteration and presentation of AI-enabled projects.
  • Provide greater scaffolding to younger learners while encouraging senior students to work with higher independence, testing depth, documentation and justification.
  • Maintain a safe, inclusive and participative learning environment and provide constructive, actionable feedback on student work.

B. Curriculum & Learning Journey Development

  • Design and develop AI curricula, modules and learning journeys for schools, educational institutions and other organisations based on learner profile, prior knowledge and desired outcomes.
  • Translate programme outcomes into structured learning sequences covering objectives, instructor preparation, materials, Responsible AI, Hook/Core/Wrap activities, student outputs, peer testing, reflection, assessment, troubleshooting and differentiation.
  • Develop lesson plans, facilitator guides, student worksheets, project briefs, prompt templates, activity sheets, assessment instruments, rubrics and capstone/project-showcase frameworks.
  • Define skill progression, prerequisite knowledge, project milestones and observable evidence of learning across beginner, intermediate and advanced learner groups.
  • Continuously improve curricula using learner performance, facilitator feedback, tool changes and programme requirements.

C. Technical Mentoring & Project Development

  • Mentor students in no-code app development, AI-assisted game development, AI-agent design, prompt engineering, digital content creation and product thinking.
  • Support learners in understanding data structure, user experience, basic databases, HTML/CSS/JavaScript logic, integrations, testing and responsible use of AI-generated code/content.
  • Prepare demonstrations, starter files, sample projects and troubleshooting guidance before sessions; test tools and workflows in advance.
  • Help students present projects professionally and explain their design choices, AI contribution, limitations, safety controls and next-step improvements.

D. Responsible AI, Assessment & Quality

  • Embed privacy, consent, copyright, attribution, bias awareness, fact-checking, hallucination management, transparency, human review and responsible publication into teaching and curriculum.
  • Assess observable evidence including understanding, prompt quality, creativity, accuracy, functionality, testing, responsible AI, collaboration, presentation and reflection.
  • Document learner progress, session observations, recurring technical issues and curriculum improvement recommendations as required by the programme team.
  • Coordinate with programme, curriculum and school stakeholders on session readiness, student support, project showcases and delivery quality.

Preferred candidate profile

Strong understanding of Generative AI, large language models, prompt engineering and safe human-AI collaboration.

  • Working knowledge of no-code/low-code app development, basic data modelling, forms, database mapping and user experience principles.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript sufficient to create, explain, test and debug beginner-to-intermediate browser-based projects.
  • Understanding of AI agents, conversational flows, instructions, knowledge sources, guardrails, testing and basic tool/integration concepts such as webhooks.
  • Understanding of creative-AI workflows for visual identity, branding, marketing content, presentations, audio/video and campaign development.
  • Knowledge of curriculum design, instructional design, project-based learning, age-appropriate pedagogy, differentiation and rubric-based assessment.
  • Strong grounding in Responsible AI, privacy, digital safety, copyright/attribution, bias, fact-checking, hallucinations and human review.

Skills - Technical & Instructional

  • Generative AI / LLM tools: hands-on proficiency with ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Microsoft Copilot or comparable LLM platforms.
  • No-code / low-code app development: working knowledge of Glide; exposure to comparable platforms such as Bubble, AppSheet, Softr, Adalo or equivalent is desirable.
  • Data and app back-end basics: Google Sheets and/or comparable structured-data tools such as Airtable; ability to explain rows, fields, categories, forms and data connections.
  • Web and game development: HTML, CSS and JavaScript; familiarity with editors/environments such as VS Code, Replit, CodePen or similar, plus browser-based testing/debugging using Chrome or equivalent.
  • AI-agent platforms: working knowledge of Botpress Studio; exposure to comparable platforms such as Voiceflow, Dialogflow, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Langflow or equivalent is desirable. Familiarity with knowledge bases, integrations and webhook concepts is an advantage.
  • Creative and brand tools: familiarity with Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Illustrator, Fresco, Character Animator, Adobe Podcast and/or comparable design, video, audio and content-creation tools such as Canva or Figma.
  • Productivity/collaboration: Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive) or equivalent productivity suites.
  • Version control and project hygiene: familiarity with backup/versioning practices; Git/GitHub or similar version-control exposure is desirable.
  • Ability to rapidly evaluate and learn emerging AI tools and determine their educational suitability, safety, accessibility and relevance to learning outcomes.
  • Strong curriculum writing, instructional documentation, presentation, facilitation and assessment-design skills.

Competencies -

  • Excellent verbal and written communication with the ability to simplify technical concepts for school learners.
  • Strong classroom presence, patience, empathy and the ability to sustain student engagement through hands-on learning.
  • Curriculum and learning-experience design mindset with strong sequencing, scaffolding and differentiation skills.
  • Problem-solving, debugging and structured experimentation; ability to model productive responses to failure and iteration.
  • Creativity, curiosity and willingness to continuously learn as AI tools and practices evolve.
  • High ownership, preparation discipline and attention to learner safety, quality and documentation.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with school leaders, teachers, programme teams and curriculum stakeholders.

TYASuite ZeroTouch is an AI-based Vendor Invoice Processing solution that helps companies automate invoice reading, data extraction, validation, approval, matching, and ERP posting. It helps finance teams reduce manual work, avoid errors, prevent duplicate invoices, and speed up invoice processing.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a confident and target-driven Pre-Sales Calling Executive who can call company-provided leads, explain the benefits of ZeroTouch, understand customer requirements, create product interest, and convert leads into scheduled demos for the sales team.


This role is mainly focused on calling, follow-up, lead qualification, and demo conversion. Leads will be provided by the company.


Candidates with excellent communication skills and strong sales performance are encouraged to apply.

  • Call leads provided by the company for the ZeroTouch product.
  • Explain ZeroTouchs AI-based invoice processing benefits to prospects.
  • Speak with CFOs, Finance Heads, Accounts Managers, Procurement Heads, and IT Heads.
  • Understand customer pain points related to manual invoice entry, approval delays, duplicate invoices, compliance issues, and ERP posting.
  • Create interest and urgency for a product demo.
  • Qualify leads based on requirement, invoice volume, company size, decision-maker availability, and interest level.
  • Convert interested leads into confirmed demo appointments.
  • Follow up regularly with prospects through calls, emails, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn.
  • Maintain proper lead status, call remarks, follow-up dates, and demo schedules in CRM.
  • Coordinate with the sales/demo team to ensure smooth handover of qualified demo leads.
  • Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly targets for calling, follow-ups, qualified leads, and demo conversions.
  • Share customer objections, feedback, and market insights with the management team.
  • Required Skills
  • Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi.
  • Strong calling, convincing, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to convert conversations into demo meetings.
  • Good understanding of B2B sales calling process.
  • Ability to confidently speak with senior-level prospects.
  • Strong objection-handling skills.
  • Target-oriented and performance-driven mindset.
  • Comfortable using CRM, Excel/Google Sheets, email, calling tools, and LinkedIn.
  • Prior experience in ERP, SaaS, software sales, finance automation, or invoice processing solutions will be preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate should have:

  • 2-5 years of experience in pre-sales calling, inside sales, tele-sales, or B2B software sales.
  • Proven experience in converting calls into product demos.
  • Experience in ERP, SaaS, AI automation, finance software, procurement software, or accounting software sales.
  • Strong professional phone etiquette.
  • Good confidence, patience, and follow-up discipline.
  • Ability to work with targets and deliver consistent demo bookings.

Qualification:

Graduate in any stream. MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or Business Development will be an added advantage.


What We Offer?

  • Opportunity to work on a fast-growing AI-based automation product.
  • Exposure to CFOs, Finance Heads, Procurement Heads, and enterprise clients.

  • Career growth in SaaS, ERP, and AI-driven automation sales.
  • Supportive and performance-oriented work environment.

jobDescription:
Role Overview:

We are seeking two skilled Data Scientists to join our engineering team to develop and implement a high-impact AI/ML predictive modeling solution. 

In this role, you will analyze historical claims data to generate VIN-level risk scoring and loss ratio forecasts for the Extended Service Business (ESB) Core Segment. 

Your work will directly influence product re-pricing and claim adjudication strategies, with a targeted objective of $1 million in annual claim cost reductions.


Key Responsibilities

  1. Model Development (Requires 35 years of experience): Design, build, and deploy end-to-end machine learning models on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to predict loss ratios and identify high-utilization contracts at the VIN level.
  2. Data Engineering & Feature Creation: Ingest and transform high-volume historical claims data from OWS and enterprise source systems; engineer robust features that capture granular risk factors.
  3. Advanced Analytics: Apply statistical modeling and ML algorithms (regression, gradient boosting, etc.) to drive proactive risk assessment and dynamic product pricing.
  4. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with business analysts and product teams to translate model outputs into actionable financial forecasting and strategic claim adjudication workflows.
  5. Operationalization: Ensure model scalability and performance monitoring, contributing to a framework designed for future expansion across global markets.

Required Technical Skills

  1. Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)specifically BigQuery, Vertex AI, and Cloud Composer.
  2. Core Data Science: Strong proficiency in Python/PySpark for data manipulation and model building (Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, or TensorFlow).
  3. Database Expertise: Advanced SQL skills for complex data retrieval, aggregation, and performance optimization within large datasets.
  4. Model Lifecycle: Demonstrated experience in the full ML lifecycle: data cleaning, feature engineering, model training, validation, and deployment (MLOps).

descriptionFromApi:
Primary Objective of the Position

The AI Solutions Developer is a hands-on technical role responsible for evaluating, developing, and maintaining Bel Fuses internal AI platform built on a custom fork of OpenWebUI. This position will assess the feasibility and complexity of extending the platform to serve as the organizations enterprise GPT solution including integrations with corporate data sources (Microsoft Fabric, ERP systems, and other business datasets via API and MCP servers), automated document generation (PDF, Word, Excel, and other formats), and robotic process automation (RPA) workflows. The AI Solutions Developer will create technical plans for these capabilities, prototype solutions, build what is validated, and ensure the platform evolves to meet the needs of business users across all divisions.

Essential Job Functions

  • Create and maintain a custom fork of OpenWebUI, evaluating the codebase for extensibility and developing a technical roadmap for customizations including user management, model routing, and platform enhancements to serve as Bel Fuses internal GPT solution
  • Assess and implement data integrations connecting the AI platform to Microsoft Fabric, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, Priority ERP, and other enterprise data sources leveraging MCP servers and existing connectors where feasible, and developing custom API integrations where code-level work is required
  • Evaluate the feasibility of and develop automated document generation capabilities within the AI platform, enabling users to produce formatted output files including PDF, Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX), PowerPoint, and CSV from AI-driven workflows
  • Create custom tools, functions, and pipelines within the AI platform to extend capabilities, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, custom model integrations, and RPA/workflow automations that connect AI outputs to business processes (e.g., Power Automate, n8n)
  • Develop and manage authentication, role-based access control, and security configurations for the AI platform in alignment with enterprise security policies and CMMC Level 2 requirements
  • Build and optimize prompt engineering templates, knowledge bases, and curated datasets to improve AI response quality and relevance for specific business functions across divisions
  • Provide technical support and training to end users on AI platform capabilities, create user documentation, and collaborate with the AI Lead on adoption and change management strategies
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and performance analytics for the AI platform, including usage metrics, response quality tracking, and system health dashboards
  • Stay current with OpenWebUI releases, LLM advancements, and emerging AI development frameworks; assess the complexity and level of effort for proposed features, prototype solutions as proof-of-concepts, and provide technical recommendations to the AI Lead

Other Responsibilities

  • Assume other projects and responsibilities from time to time as directed.
  • Regular and predictable attendance is presumed to be an essential function of all employment.
  • Establish and maintain a positive working relationship within assigned teams and with all applicable departments, customers, and vendors. Seek mutual agreement on problems involving coordination.



Education and Experience (Qualifications)

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field.
  • 3+ years of experience in software development, with at least 1 year focused on AI/ML applications, LLM integrations, or AI platform development
  • Hands-on experience with OpenWebUI, LangChain, or similar open-source AI platforms and frameworks
  • Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with experience building REST APIs and working with cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure)
  • Experience with API integration development and cloud services (Microsoft Azure), including connecting to enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, SQL databases, and ERP system APIs
  • Working knowledge of document generation libraries and techniques for producing PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and other output formats programmatically
  • Familiarity with enterprise ERP systems (Oracle EBS, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar), RPA/workflow automation tools (Power Automate, n8n, or similar), and understanding of manufacturing business processes is a plus
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently, manage multiple development tasks concurrently, and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Competencies For This Position (KSAAS)

Business Skills: Demonstrates a solid understanding of how AI solutions address business needs; able to translate user requirements into technical designs and platform features. A working knowledge of manufacturing operations, supply chain, finance, and sales processes will be important as the AI platform will serve users across these areas.

Knowledge: Ability to satisfactorily complete and implement all OJT and required trainings.
Ability to understand the organization structure, businesses and sites, and applying that knowledge to project planning, stakeholder engagement, and cross-site coordination.

Computer Skills: To perform this job successfully, an individual should have advanced knowledge of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern web frameworks. Experience with Microsoft Azure, Git version control, REST API development, and Linux server administration is required. Familiarity with the Microsoft Office Suite, database query languages (SQL), enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, and RPA/workflow automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, n8n, or similar) is expected.

Ability to anticipate, negotiate and manage conflicts, problems, changing situations and deadlines across diverse stakeholder groups and time zones.

Job Title
