POSITION OVERVIEW


The Data Scientist - Drug Repurposing will design and apply Natural Language Processing (NLP), graph-based, and deep learning models to identify new therapeutic applications for existing drugs. Working within a multidisciplinary team of researchers, data scientists, and bioinformaticians, this role will mine large-scale biomedical data including literature, clinical trial records, and multi-omics datasets to surface hidden patterns and translate them into actionable drug repurposing hypotheses.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


  • NLP for Biomedical Text: Develop and apply NLP pipelines (named entity recognition, relation extraction, literature mining) to extract drug, gene, disease, and pathway information from biomedical literature, clinical trial registries, and electronic health records.

  • Graph-Based Modelling: Design and implement knowledge graphs and graph neural network (GNN) models to represent drug-target-disease interactions and uncover novel repurposing candidates.

  • Deep Learning for Efficacy & Safety Prediction: Build and validate deep learning models to predict drug efficacy, safety signals, and potential new indications from heterogeneous datasets.

  • Multi-Omics Data Integration: Integrate and analyze genomic, proteomic, transcriptomic, and phenotypic data alongside clinical and real-world evidence to identify and priorities repurposing opportunities.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with bioinformaticians, clinical scientists, and product teams to translate model outputs into validated, actionable insights and communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Model Lifecycle Ownership: Own model development end-to-end data acquisition, preprocessing, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring with attention to reproducibility and documentation.

  • Staying Current: Track and evaluate emerging methods in NLP, graph learning, deep learning, and computational drug repurposing, recommending adoption where relevant.

Education & Experience


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Biology, or a related field.

Technical Skills

AI Powered Tech Talent You will design, configure, and enhance SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) processes while leveraging AI assisted development tools and copilots to speed up requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting. Configure and optimize SAP SD components including:
o Order Management
o Pricing, Conditions & Discounts
o Delivery & Shipment Processing
o Billing & Invoicing
o Credit Management
o Returns & Refunds

o Test planning and execution

o Smart summarization of order/delivery issues

Partner with logistics, finance, supply chain, master data, and technical teams to deliver end to end O2C alignment.
Contribute reusable templates, test packs, and best practices enhanced by AI assisted accelerators.

SAP SD Expertise
Strong understanding of O2C processes including order creation, ATP, shipping, billing, credit checks, and pricing procedures.

Ability to integrate pre built AI capabilities (not developing custom LLMs or agentic systems) into SD process flows.
Understanding of responsible AI usage and limitations, especially in commercial workflows.
General Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving capabilities in O2C scenarios.
Ability to translate business requirements into scalable SAP SD configurations.
Effective communication and collaboration skills with cross functional stakeholders.
Continuous learning mindset and comfort using AI augmented productivity tools.

Good to Have
SAP SD Certification (S/4HANA Sales).
Experience with SAP Fiori apps (Sales Order, Billing, Pricing).
Exposure to EDI/IDoc integrations, middleware (CPI/Boomi), or CRM systems.
Familiarity with automation testing tools.

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more accurate, and more transparent SD solutions using AI Assisted productivity accelerators.
Improve O2C efficiency, pricing accuracy, and billing reliability.
Act as an effective bridge between Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and AI native teams when deeper AI involvement is required.

Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and hands-on Associate Manager/Manager – Learning Content to design and develop engaging digital learning experiences for a large and diverse workforce. This role is ideal for professionals who are passionate about Instructional Design, storytelling, and creating impactful learning content using modern digital learning tools.

You will work closely with business leaders and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to transform business knowledge into interactive learning solutions, including e-learning modules, storyboards, videos, assessments, and learning journeys.

If you enjoy building learner-centric experiences and have strong expertise in Articulate Storyline and Instructional Design, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop engaging digital learning content, including e-learning modules, storyboards, scripts, facilitator guides, and job aids.

  • Develop interactive courses using Articulate Storyline, Rise, or similar authoring tools.
  • Create visual learning concepts, storytelling frameworks, and mood boards to enhance learner engagement.
  • Collaborate with SMEs and stakeholders to gather content and validate learning solutions.
  • Publish and manage courses on Learning Management Systems (LMS/LXP).
  • Curate relevant learning resources and organize them into structured learning pathways.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve content development and learner experience.
  • Monitor learner engagement and continuously improve content based on analytics and feedback.

Ideal Candidate

  • 5–8 years of experience in Instructional Design, Digital Learning, Learning Content Development, or E-learning.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Articulate Storyline (mandatory).
  • Experience creating storyboards, scripts, learning journeys, and interactive digital learning content.
  • Knowledge of SCORM, LMS/LXP platforms, and digital learning ecosystems.
  • Exposure to AI-powered content creation tools is an advantage.
  • Strong communication, creativity, and stakeholder management skills.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
  • Certification in Instructional Design or Learning Technologies is preferred.

Experience

  • 5–10 years

Please Note: This is a hands-on content creation role. We are looking for professionals who have personally designed and developed digital learning content, not candidates whose experience is limited to classroom training delivery or training coordination.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Meet the Team:

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. We design the networking hardware for Enterprises and Service Providers of various sizes, the Public Sector, and Non-Profit Organizations across the world. Cisco Silicon One (#CiscoSiliconOne) is the only unifying silicon architecture in the market that enables customers to deploy the best-of-breed silicon from Top of Rack (TOR) switches all the way through web scale data centers and across service provider, enterprise networks, and data centers with a fully unified routing and switching portfolio.

Your Impact:

Responsible for implementing the Hardware Design-for-Test (DFT) features that support ATE, in-system test, debug and diagnostics needs of the designs.

Responsible for development of innovative DFT IP in collaboration with the multi-functional teams, and play a key role in full chip design integration with the testability features coordinated in the RTL.

Work closely with the design/design-verification and PD teams to enable the integration and validation of the Test logic in all phases of the implementation and post silicon validation flows.

Your team will participate in the creation of Innovative Hardware DFT physical design aspects for new silicon device models, bare die stacked die, driving re-usable test and debug strategies.

The job requires the candidate to have the ability to craft solutions and debug with minimal mentorship.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors or a Master s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering required with at least 4-8 years of experience.
  • Knowledge of the latest innovative trends in DFT, test and silicon engineering.
  • Experience with JTAG protocols, Scan and BIST architectures, including memory BIST and boundary scan.
  • Experience with ATPG and EDA tools like TestMax, Tetramax, Tessent tool sets, PrimeTime
  • Verification skills include, System Verilog Logic Equivalency checking and validating the Test-timing of the design
  • Experience working with Gate level simulation, debugging with VCS and other simulators.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Post-silicon validation and debug experience; Ability to work with ATE patterns, P1687
  • Strong verbal skills and ability to thrive in a multifaceted environment
  • Scripting skills: Tcl, Python/Perl.

title: Product Support Analyst-1
jobDescription:
Job Summary
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .
Application Support Analyst (Level 1/2)
The Application Support Analyst provides Level 1 and Level 2 support for JLL Technologies (JLLT) applications, partnering with customers and internal teams to troubleshoot issues, resolve cases within service targets, and improve the customer experience through documentation and knowledge sharing.
Work model/location: Remote (India).
Travel/on-call: None. May participate in an after-hours on-call rotation.
Required hours
  • Monday-Friday, aligned to U.S. business hours. Shift will be 8am-5pm Central Time
Responsibilities
  • Provide Level 1 and Level 2 application support via phone and email for JLLT product applications, including: Archibus, FMSE, FMSW, FMS Space, Maximo, TRIRIGA, Eptura Workplace, SERRAVIEW, OSIS, Nuvolo, Saltmine, AutoCAD, Envizi, and Zendesk
  • Monitor the incoming case queue and identify emergency, high-priority, or escalated issues.
  • Receive inbound calls from customers and gather details, guide customers through troubleshooting steps, and understand customer workflows
  • Make outbound calls as needed to gather details, guide customers through troubleshooting steps, and understand customer workflows.
  • Own assigned cases through resolution and deliver solutions within defined SLOs/SLAs.
  • Troubleshoot, test, and research complex scenarios to determine root cause, impact/scope, workarounds, and verification steps for defect reports.
  • Develop a broad understanding of supported products, workflows, features, integrations, and how they are used across the customer base.
  • Document troubleshooting steps, findings, and recommendations; escalate to Level 3 when appropriate.
  • Stay current on feature releases, known issues, workarounds, and support processes (Release Management).
  • Collaborate with partner teams and departments to build relationships and identify opportunities for cross-functional improvements.
  • Support special projects and ad hoc tasks as requested.
  • Provide real-time support to the team by answering questions and offering guidance.
  • Develop areas of expertise and serve as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Champion customer satisfaction (CSAT) outcomes for the Support team.
  • Contribute to the Knowledge Base by documenting known solutions and creating/updating support articles.
  • Maintain and deepen understanding of application features and functionality.
Required skills
  • Excellent customer service skills (written and verbal)
  • Ability to investigate and document complex issues clearly for escalation
  • Ability to explain complex situations to a wide audience
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to mentor and support junior team members
  • Quick learner of new technologies and processes
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively as part of a team
  • Ability to de-escalate customer situations and deliver a positive customer experience
  • Knowledge of the real estate industry and real estate technology
Preferred qualifications
  • Prior experience in a SaaS or enterprise application support/help desk environment
  • Experience with ITSM/ticketing tools (e.g., ServiceNow or Zendesk) and SLA/SLO-driven support
  • Basic SQL skills and/or experience analyzing logs, APIs, or integrations
  • Experience supporting any of the listed platforms (e.g., Archibus, TRIRIGA, Maximo, Nuvolo, Serraview, Eptura Workplace)
  • Real estate, facilities management, IWMS/CAFM, or workplace technology domain experience
Potential JLLT career paths
  • Based on proven expertise and business need, potential career paths may include: Level 3: Corrigo IntegrationLevel 3: Archibus DeveloperLevel 3: Maximo DeveloperLevel 3: TRIRIGA DeveloperLevel 3: Systems Integration (Hosting)
Location: Aurangabad, MH
Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40

title: Workplace Experience Enabler
jobDescription:
Job Summary

This position is in its nature proactive and focused on the detail, to ensure workplace services are delivered to an agreed consistent standard to enable Occupant and Guest Experience based on requirements "works every time", while maintaining safe working practices throughout all we do.

The role actively ensures the day to day service delivery by the Workplace team and vendor partners, ensuring compliance to SOPs and SLAs. Importantly alignment must prevail with the Workplace Experience team to ensure service delivery to the ultimate target of creating Customer Delight, with agility of mind, and so service provision, to maintain this alignment.

Job Details

Job Location: Bangalore

Position: Workplace Experience Enabler

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Hotel Management (mandatory)
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in facility management or hospitality industry

Work Arrangement

  • Schedule: 6-day work week
  • Timing: Rotating shifts
  • Availability: Immediate joiners preferred

Eligibility

Open to all genders

Responsibilities

  • Commitment to deliver the best level of service every time through obsessive level of attention detail
  • Ensures resets back to agreed format, including owning Clear Desk policy / Lost property process enactment and associated reporting to Workplace Experience team to allow for onward sharing with LOBs

  • Functional operational control to deliver excellence every time
  • Implement service tasks, procedures and policies and measure performance
  • Review and spot-check suppliers/service providers performance to ensure contractual obligations are delivered
  • Understand the operational technical requirements of the site and ensure that current contracts are maintained to provide necessary supplies and services
  • Provide comprehensive workplace management for the office premises
  • Implement and manage the change control process
  • Resolve users complaints and concerns with solutions and follow up
  • Be able to resolve problems or improve operations
  • Implementation of service tasks, procedures and policies
  • Prepare risk assessments for self-delivery
  • Assist with critical out-of-hours issues participate as a key team member in responses to emergency situations
  • Report building incident following with set escalation channels with measures and solutions
  • Responsible for monitoring and managing staff performance with criteria set in Individual Performance Management
  • Coordinate, manage and oversee vendors to perform a wide range of workplace related services
  • Ensure service deliverables meet SLAs and KPIs
  • Work with all related parties on timely delivery of all services
  • Ensuring up to date information on Clients Property Services SharePoint
  • When necessary raise risks to Workplace Experience Site Lead for further investigation
  • Continuous Improvement implementation
  • Cost saving mind-set that drives value for service as every level
  • Conduct data analysis report when necessary

Ideal Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A minimum of 3 years in the facility management industry/hospitality industry
  • An added benefit would be a Bachelors degree in facilities management, building, business or other related field; however, this is not a must.

Other Personal Characteristics

  • Detail focused and proactive in nature
  • Self-motivated
  • Exhibits honesty trustworthiness
  • Open to new ideas willing to challenge status quo

Location

On-site - Bengaluru, KA

Scheduled Weekly Hours

Job Summary

The CASB team within Cisco Secure Access develops cloud-delivered security capabilities that help organizations safely adopt cloud applications. A Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) acts as an intermediary between users and cloud service providers. It provides cloud application visibility, shadow IT discovery, and data loss prevention (DLP) across sanctioned and unsanctioned applications.

Our team builds scalable backend services that process complex security data flows and protect sensitive information.

ud environments.

Your Impact

We are looking for a motivated backend software engineer to join our CASB engineering team. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain cloud-native backend services using Golang, Node.js, and Python.

You will collaborate with engineers, architects, product managers, security specialists, and operations teams to deliver reliable security capabilities at cloud scale. This role offers opportunities to work with distributed systems, microservices, AWS, data-processing pipelines, observability, and deployment automation.

The ideal candidate has strong software-engineering fundamentals, enjoys solving technical problems, and is interested in cloud and cybersecurity technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services using Golang, Node.js, and Python.

title: Oracle Fusion Financials Technical Consultant
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Cisco IT is a transformation engine enabling people to do the best work of their lives! Our vision is to be loved as the world s best IT organization. We lead with user experience, accept agile ways of working, drive engineering efficiency, and deliver with Cloud first, shift left, AI powered technology.

The Component Operations Supply Chain IT team is at the forefront of transforming our supply chain through technology. We specialize in implementing and optimizing our Supply Chain ERP solution, a critical backbone for managing everything from procurement to delivery. Our expertise ensures seamless integration of processes, providing real-time visibility and control over our entire supply chain operations. We empower data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve overall operational agility.

Your Impact

We are looking for 7+ years of hands-on experience working with Oracle Fusion Financials and possess strong technical expertise in Oracle Fusion data models, integrations, reporting, and security.

Responsibilities

  • Build and support integrations between Oracle Fusion and external applications using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, FBDI, UCM, and ESS Jobs.
  • Support the Month End close process for Account Payables, Procurement, Costing and General Ledger
  • Develop, customize, and support Oracle Fusion Financials technical solutions.
  • Design, develop, and optimize SQL queries for reporting, data extraction, perform SQL performance tuning and troubleshooting for Oracle Fusion data models.
  • Support technical design, development, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Collaborate with functional consultants to understand business requirements and deliver scalable technical solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Oracle Fusion Financials.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4-8 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Financials.
  • Strong technical knowledge of the following Oracle Fusion modules:
  • General Ledger (GL)
  • Accounts Payable (AP)
  • Procurement
  • Cost Management (Costing)
  • Subledger Accounting (SLA)
  • Strong understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials data models and database architecture.
  • Experience in working and resolving issues during the Month End close for Account Payables, Procurement, Costing and General Ledger
  • Expertise in Oracle SQL, including writing complex queries and performance tuning.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, FBDI, UCM, and ESS Jobs for integrations.
  • Good understanding of Oracle Fusion security concepts, including Security Roles, Data Access Sets, Duty Roles, and Job Roles.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with BI Publisher and OTBI reporting.
  • Knowledge of SOAP web services and FBDI.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
  • Exposure to Oracle Fusion Redwood UX and modern Oracle Cloud technologies is an added advantage.

Job Summary

Product Support Specialist-2

We are currently seeking an Enhanced Support Specialist specializing in Tier 2 client technical support to join our JLL Technologies Corrigo Support team.

Required hours

  • Monday-Friday, aligned to U.S. business hours. Shift will be 8am-5pm Central Time.

  • The majority of this role will be troubleshooting various and complex Corrigo issues
  • Manage Incidents and Service Requests in multiple ticketing queues for multiple applications
  • Be available for chat and live call transfers from OSC Corrigo L1
  • Engage in mentoring sessions with OSC L1 Response Team members
  • Assist in creating user-facing Knowledge Articles that facilitate user self-help
  • Participate in post-migration application testing
  • Test complex scenarios to determine cause, symptoms, scope, alternative workflow, solutions and verification of defect reports
  • Document steps, findings, suggestions and escalate to Tier 3
  • Go above standard Response Team Support troubleshooting methods by performing tests, doing research, and engaging with others within and outside of the Support Department to obtain full understanding
  • Make outbound calls to gather details, work through specific steps, and gain understanding of specific workflows to fully understand the reported issue
  • Develop and maintain understanding of application features and functionality
  • Collaborate with the Learning Team on updates to training and support information
  • Ability to work reliably and consistently from home - this is a virtual position
  • Stay up to date on new features, releases, known issues, work arounds and processes
  • Develop areas of expertise in Corrigo Applications and become Subject Matter Expert

Core Skillsets

  • Advanced troubleshooting ability and logic
  • Independently motivated
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Superior proactive customer service skills
  • Superior troubleshooting skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to engage and communicate with our clients and diverse employees
  • Previous ITIL training and knowledge
  • Previous experience and competence with an ITIL ticketing tool like Salesforce/ServiceCloud

Education and experience

  • (3+) years of work experience collaborating with teams in a matrix leadership environment (Required)
  • (5+) years of relevant/professional experience related (Required)
  • Experience in Real Estate industry experience (Preferred)

title: AI Agent Engineer
tagsAndSkills: generative ai,Langchain,Prompt Engineering,Meta Cloud API,Python,Anthropic Claude,API Integration,Unit Testing
jobDescription:
Poaition: AI Agent Engineer

Reports to: Head of Engineering / CEO

Works with: Lead Developer, Plant Management, HR

Location: Pune, India

Type: Full-time, permanent

Experience: 3+ years software engineering, with hands-on LLM application work


Purpose of the role:

To own MetisEI's AI agent layer end-to-end. We are rolling out approximately 30 agents spanning production, supply chain, quality, HR and finance. Several are already live at CT Mexico. These agents send reports and instructions directly to line managers and plant staff, largely over WhatsApp so reliability is the job, not a nice-to-have.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design, build and maintain the agent layer production efficiency reporting, workforce and absence reporting, supply chain, quality and finance agents.
  • Enforce the deterministic/LLM boundary. All arithmetic, thresholds, bucketing, ranking and fixed content must be computed and validated in code. The LLM is used for natural language rewriting of a pre-verified output only.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites and evaluation harnesses for every agent. Agents must be regression-tested before any prompt or logic change reaches a live recipient.
  • Build output validation that blocks a message from sending if it fails its rules, rather than relying on the model to comply.
  • Configure and operate the WhatsApp Business Platform (Meta Cloud API) business account and number setup, message template submission and approval, webhook handling, delivery and read receipts, error and retry handling, opt-in management, rate limits and quality rating.
  • Build scheduled delivery pipelines (daily and weekly cadences, timezone-correct per site) including PDF report generation and attachment.
  • Work directly with plant management and HR to specify agent behaviour, then translate that into testable rules.
  • Maintain a versioned content library (tips, templates, standard messaging) with verbatim-copy guarantees where required.

Essential requirements:

  • Strong Python. This role writes real software, not just prompts.
  • Hands-on production experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or equivalent) not experimental or personal-project only.
  • Demonstrable experience building evaluation and testing frameworks for non-deterministic systems.
  • Practical understanding of where LLMs fail and how to constrain them structured output, validation, guardrails, fallbacks.
  • WhatsApp Business Platform / Meta Cloud API configuration experience, or equivalent messaging platform integration (Twilio, SMS gateways) with clear ability to pick up WhatsApp specifics.
  • Webhook and asynchronous job/scheduling experience.
  • Ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and convert loose requirements into precise, testable rules.

Desirable:

  • PDF and report generation.
  • Retrieval-augmented generation and vector databases (Qdrant).
  • Manufacturing or operations domain exposure.
  • Spanish.
